title.zh: 卷四十四 本紀第四十四 理宗四
title.raw: 卷四十四 本紀第四十四 理宗四 Volume 44 Annals 44: Lizong 4

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙亥朔，大元城利州、閬州。

translations.literal: In the second year, first month of spring, on yihai the new moon day, Great Yuan fortified Lizhou and Langzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the new moon of the first month of spring, yihai, the Great Yuan fortified Lizhou and Langzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔湘潭縣民陳克良孝行，表其門。

translations.literal: An edict noted the filial conduct of Chen Keliang, a commoner of Xiangtan County, and honored his gate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended the filial conduct of Chen Keliang of Xiangtan County and ordered an honorific tablet placed at his gate.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰朔，詔太常厘正秦檜諡，因諭輔臣曰：「諡'繆狠'可也。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiachen the new moon day, an edict ordered the Directorate of Ceremonies to rectify Qin Hui's posthumous title, and the emperor told his chief ministers, "The posthumous title 'Deceitful and Fierce' would be appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon, jiachen, an edict ordered the Directorate of Ceremonies to rectify Qin Hui's posthumous title, and the emperor told his chief ministers, "The posthumous title Deceitful and Fierce would be fitting."

sentences.zh: 」熒惑犯權星。

translations.literal: Mars transgressed the Authority Star.
translations.idiomatic: Mars transgressed the Authority Star.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔利州統制呂達戰沒，贈官四轉，官一子承信郎，一子下班祗應。

translations.literal: On yisi an edict noted that Lü Da, commander of Lizhou, had died in battle; he was posthumously promoted four ranks, one son was appointed Gentleman for Trustworthiness, and one son was made a lower-ranking attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi an edict noted that Lü Da, the Lizhou commander, had fallen in battle; he was posthumously promoted four ranks, one son was appointed Gentleman for Trustworthiness, and one son was made a lower-ranking attendant.

sentences.zh: 己酉，余晦兼四川屯田使。

translations.literal: On jiyou Yu Hui was additionally appointed Sichuan commissioner of military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Yu Hui was additionally appointed Sichuan commissioner of military colonies.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔饒州布衣饒魯不事科舉，一意經學，補迪功郎、饒州教授。

translations.literal: On gengshen an edict noted that Rao Lu, a commoner of Raozhou who had not pursued the civil examinations and had devoted himself solely to classical learning, was appointed Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement and professor at Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict noted that Rao Lu, a Raozhou commoner who had shunned the civil examinations and devoted himself solely to classical learning, was appointed Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement and professor at Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，日暈周匝。

translations.literal: On xinyou a complete solar halo appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou a complete solar halo appeared.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，故直華文閣李燔，先儒朱熹門人，賜諡文定。

translations.literal: On wuchen the late Li Fan, direct attendant of the Huawen Pavilion and a disciple of the earlier Confucian Zhu Xi, was granted the posthumous title Wending.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the late Li Fan, direct attendant of the Huawen Pavilion and a disciple of the earlier Confucian Zhu Xi, was granted the posthumous title Wending.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，王元善使大元，留七年來歸。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renwu, Wang Yuanshan, who had been sent as envoy to Great Yuan and detained for seven years, returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renwu, Wang Yuanshan, who had been sent as envoy to the Great Yuan and detained for seven years, returned home.

sentences.zh: 戊子，雪。

translations.literal: On wuzi it snowed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi it snowed.

sentences.zh: 詔蠲江、淮今年二稅。

translations.literal: An edict remitted this year's two levies in the Jiang and Huai regions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict remitted this year's two tax levies in the Jiang and Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔錄襄城功，高達帶行環衛官、遙郡團練使，職任依舊；

translations.literal: On jichou an edict recorded the merit at Xiangcheng: Gao Da was granted acting status as a guard officer and remote-prefecture regiment trainer, with his duties unchanged;
translations.idiomatic: On jichou an edict recorded the merit at Xiangcheng: Gao Da was granted acting status as a guard officer and remote-prefecture regiment trainer, with his duties unchanged;

sentences.zh: 王登行軍器監丞、制司參議官；

translations.literal: Wang Deng was made acting supervisor of the Directorate of Military Equipment and strategic-planning commissioner advisor;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Deng was made acting supervisor of the Directorate of Military Equipment and strategic-planning commissioner advisor;

sentences.zh: 程大元、李和以下將士六千六百一十三人補轉官資有差。

translations.literal: Cheng Dayuan, Li He, and the officers and soldiers below them, six thousand six hundred thirteen in all, were promoted in rank with distinctions according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Dayuan, Li He, and the officers and soldiers below them—six thousand six hundred thirteen in all—were promoted in rank with distinctions according to merit.

sentences.zh: 甲午，城東海，賈似道以圖來上。

translations.literal: On jiawu Donghai was fortified, and Jia Sidao submitted a map of the work.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Donghai was fortified, and Jia Sidao submitted a map of the work.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，詔邊兵貧困可閔，閒田甚多，擇其近便者分給耕種，制司守臣治之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on xinhai, an edict noted that the poverty of border troops was pitiable and that much idle land lay available; nearby plots were to be selected and distributed for cultivation, to be administered by the strategic commissioners and prefectural officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinhai, an edict noted that border troops were pitiably poor and that much idle land lay available; nearby plots were to be selected and distributed for cultivation, to be administered by the strategic commissioners and prefectural officials.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以徐清叟知樞密院兼參知政事，董槐參知政事。

translations.literal: On yichou Xu Qingsou was appointed commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and Dong Huai was appointed vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Xu Qingsou was appointed commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and Dong Huai was appointed vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅朔，罷臨安府臨平鎮稅場。

translations.literal: On the new moon of the sixth month, renyin, the Linping tax station in Lin'an Prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the sixth month, renyin, the Linping tax station in Lin'an Prefecture was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，四川制司言：合州、廣安軍北兵入境，王堅、曹世雄等戰禦有功。

translations.literal: On jiachen the Sichuan strategic office reported that Northern troops had entered Hezhou and Guangan Army; Wang Jian, Cao Shixiong, and others had fought in defense with merit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Sichuan strategic office reported that Northern troops had entered Hezhou and Guangan Army; Wang Jian, Cao Shixiong, and others had fought in defense with merit.

sentences.zh: 詔堅官兩轉，餘各補轉官資。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wang Jian promoted two ranks, and the others promoted in rank according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Wang Jian promoted two ranks, and the others promoted in rank according to merit.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，侍御史吳燧等論故蜀帥余玠聚斂罔利七罪，玠死，其子如孫盡竊帑庾之積以歸。

translations.literal: On jiayin the attendant censor Wu Sui and others charged the late Sichuan commander Yu Jie with seven crimes of extortion and illicit profit; after Yu Jie's death his son Rusun had stolen the entire accumulated treasury stores and taken them home.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the attendant censor Wu Sui and others charged the late Sichuan commander Yu Jie with seven crimes of extortion and illicit profit; after Yu Jie's death his son Rusun had stolen the entire accumulated treasury stores and taken them home.

sentences.zh: 詔簿錄玠家財。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yu Jie's family property inventoried.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yu Jie's family property inventoried.

sentences.zh: 以李曾伯爲資政殿學士，依舊節制四川。

translations.literal: Li Zengbo was appointed academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and continued to control Sichuan as before.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zengbo was appointed academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and continued to control Sichuan as before.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，利州王佐堅守孤壘，降將南永忠以兵薄城下，佐罵之，永忠流涕而退。

translations.literal: On bingchen Wang Zuo of Lizhou held fast in an isolated fortress; the defector Nan Yongzhong pressed the city with troops, Wang Zuo cursed him, and Nan Yongzhong wept as he withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Wang Zuo of Lizhou held fast in an isolated fortress; the defector Nan Yongzhong pressed the city with troops, Wang Zuo cursed him, and Nan Yongzhong wept as he withdrew.

sentences.zh: 初，隆慶教授鄭炳孫不從南永忠降，先縊死其妻女，亦朝服自縊。

translations.literal: Earlier, Zheng Bingsun, professor at Longqing, had refused to surrender with Nan Yongzhong; he first hanged his wife and daughter, then hanged himself in court dress.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Zheng Bingsun, professor at Longqing, had refused to surrender with Nan Yongzhong; he first hanged his wife and daughter, then hanged himself in court dress.

sentences.zh: 詔獎諭：佐進官一秩，炳孫贈朝奉郎、直秘閣，仍訪其子，官以文資。

translations.literal: An edict of commendation ordered Wang Zuo promoted one rank; Zheng Bingsun was posthumously granted Gentleman for Court Service and direct attendant of the Secretariat Pavilion, and his son was to be sought out and given a civil appointment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict of commendation ordered Wang Zuo promoted one rank; Zheng Bingsun was posthumously granted Gentleman for Court Service and direct attendant of the Secretariat Pavilion, and his son was to be sought out and given a civil appointment.

sentences.zh: 王伯大乞致仕，詔進一秩，允所請。

translations.literal: Wang Boda requested retirement; an edict promoted him one rank and granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Boda requested retirement; an edict promoted him one rank and granted his request.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以賈似道同知樞密院事，職任依舊。

translations.literal: On dingsi Jia Sidao was appointed vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, with his duties unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Jia Sidao was appointed vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, with his duties unchanged.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔余晦赴闕。

translations.literal: On gengwu an edict ordered Yu Hui to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu an edict ordered Yu Hui to come to court.

sentences.zh: 閏六月壬申，董槐疏：蜀事孔棘，願假臣宣撫之名，置司夔門，以通荊、蜀。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month, on renshen, Dong Huai submitted a memorial: affairs in Shu were critically urgent; he wished to be granted the title of pacification commissioner, to establish an office at Kuimen and thereby link Jing and Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, on renshen, Dong Huai submitted a memorial: affairs in Shu were critically urgent; he wished to be granted the title of pacification commissioner, to establish an office at Kuimen and thereby link Jing and Shu.

sentences.zh: 上優詔答曰：「士大夫以事功自勉者鮮，卿請帥蜀，足見忠壯。

translations.literal: The emperor replied with a gracious edict: "Few among the scholar-officials urge themselves on by achievement; your request to command Shu shows ample loyalty and courage."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied with a gracious edict: "Few among the scholar-officials urge themselves on by achievement; your request to command Shu shows ample loyalty and courage."

sentences.zh: 然經理西事，當在廟堂，宜竭謀猷，以副委任。

translations.literal: "Yet managing western affairs should be done from the court; you should exhaust your counsel and strategy to fulfill the commission entrusted to you."
translations.idiomatic: "Yet managing western affairs should be done from the court; you should exhaust your counsel and strategy to fulfill the commission entrusted to you."

sentences.zh: 」詔蒲擇之暫權四川制置司事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Pu Zhezhi temporarily to take charge of the Sichuan strategic office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Pu Zhezhi temporarily to take charge of the Sichuan strategic office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，錄嘉定戰功。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the merit of the Jiading campaign was recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the merit of the Jiading campaign was recorded.

sentences.zh: 先是，大元兵圍城五旬，帥守俞興、元用等夜開關力戰而圍解。

translations.literal: Earlier, Great Yuan troops had besieged the city for fifty days; the commander-defenders Yu Xing, Yuan Yong, and others opened the gate by night and fought fiercely until the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Great Yuan troops had besieged the city for fifty days; the commander-defenders Yu Xing, Yuan Yong, and others opened the gate by night and fought fiercely until the siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 詔俞興等十六人各官五轉，將士補轉有差。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yu Xing and the other fifteen men each promoted five ranks, with officers and soldiers promoted according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yu Xing and the other fifteen men each promoted five ranks, with officers and soldiers promoted according to merit.

sentences.zh: 以包恢提點浙西刑獄，招捕荻浦鹽寇。

translations.literal: Bao Hui was appointed judicial intendant of western Zhejiang to recruit forces and capture the salt bandits of Dipu.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Hui was appointed judicial intendant of western Zhejiang to recruit forces and capture the salt bandits of Dipu.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，台州海寇積年，民罹其害，路分董橚洎進士周自中等擒獲，詔橚官一轉，餘推賞有差。

translations.literal: On yihai sea bandits in Taizhou, who had plagued the people for years, were captured by Route Commander Dong Shu and the presented scholar Zhou Zizhong and others; an edict ordered Dong Shu promoted one rank, with the others rewarded according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai sea bandits in Taizhou, who had plagued the people for years, were captured by Route Commander Dong Shu and the presented scholar Zhou Zizhong and others; an edict ordered Dong Shu promoted one rank, with the others rewarded according to merit.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以李曾伯爲四川宣撫使兼京湖制置大使，進司夔路，詔賜曾伯同進士出身。

translations.literal: On renwu Li Zengbo was appointed Sichuan pacification commissioner and concurrent grand commissioner of Jing-Hu strategic affairs, advancing to take charge of Kuilu; an edict granted Li Zengbo status equal to a jinshi degree holder.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Li Zengbo was appointed Sichuan pacification commissioner and concurrent grand commissioner of Jing-Hu strategic affairs, advancing to take charge of Kuilu; an edict granted Li Zengbo status equal to a jinshi degree holder.

sentences.zh: 罷江灣浮鹽局，戊戌，大元使離揚州北歸。

translations.literal: The Jiangwan floating-salt bureau was abolished; on wuxu the Great Yuan envoy left Yangzhou and returned north.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangwan floating-salt bureau was abolished; on wuxu the Great Yuan envoy left Yangzhou and returned north.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，詔「前蜀帥余玠鎮撫無狀，兵苦於征戌，民困於徵求，茲俾其家輸所取蜀財，犒師振民；

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiyou, an edict declared, "The former Sichuan commander Yu Jie governed without proper conduct; troops suffered under repeated campaigns and the people were exhausted by exactions; now his family is ordered to surrender the wealth taken from Shu to reward the army and relieve the people;"
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiyou, an edict declared, "The former Sichuan commander Yu Jie governed without proper conduct; troops suffered under repeated campaigns and the people were exhausted by exactions; now his family is ordered to surrender the wealth taken from Shu to reward the army and relieve the people;"

sentences.zh: 並邊諸郡田租，其復三年。

translations.literal: "and land tax in the border prefectures is remitted for three years."
translations.idiomatic: "and land tax in the border prefectures is remitted for three years."

sentences.zh: 」詔思、播兩州連年捍禦，其守臣田應庚、楊文各官一轉，餘推恩。

translations.literal: An edict noted that Si and Bo prefectures had defended themselves year after year; their prefects Tian Yinggeng and Yang Wen were each promoted one rank, with further honors distributed according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict noted that Si and Bo prefectures had defended themselves year after year; their prefects Tian Yinggeng and Yang Wen were each promoted one rank, with further honors distributed according to merit.

sentences.zh: 詔賈似道開閫，以樞密行府爲名。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Jia Sidao to open a command headquarters under the name of the Bureau of Military Affairs field office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Jia Sidao to open a command headquarters under the name of the Bureau of Military Affairs field office.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: On gengxu a meteor as large as Venus appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu a meteor as large as Venus appeared.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，故光祿大夫賈涉諡忠肅。

translations.literal: On jiayin the late Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Jia She was granted the posthumous title Zhongsu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the late Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Jia She was granted the posthumous title Zhongsu.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，復安西堡。

translations.literal: On renxu Anxi Fort was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Anxi Fort was restored.

sentences.zh: 己巳，荻浦海寇平，包恢進直龍圖閣，劉達授橫行、帶遙郡。

translations.literal: On jisi the Dipu sea bandits were subdued; Bao Hui was promoted to direct attendant of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, and Liu Da was granted hengxing status with a remote prefecture title.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Dipu sea bandits were subdued; Bao Hui was promoted to direct attendant of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, and Liu Da was granted hengxing status with a remote prefecture title.

sentences.zh: 李性傳赴闕，以王堅爲興元都統兼知合州。

translations.literal: Li Xingchuan came to court; Wang Jian was appointed commander-in-chief at Xingyuan and concurrent prefect of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xingchuan came to court; Wang Jian was appointed commander-in-chief at Xingyuan and concurrent prefect of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，詔以前知閬州兼利西安撫王惟忠付大理獄，尋命台臣監鞫。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yihai, an edict ordered the former Langzhou prefect and concurrent Li Xi pacification commissioner Wang Weizhong handed over to the Dali prison; censorial officials were soon ordered to supervise the investigation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yihai, an edict ordered the former Langzhou prefect and concurrent Li Xi pacification commissioner Wang Weizhong handed over to the Dali prison; censorial officials were soon ordered to supervise the investigation.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，徐清叟乞罷機務，詔不允。

translations.literal: On xinsi Xu Qingsou requested to be relieved of state affairs; an edict refused.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Xu Qingsou requested to be relieved of state affairs; an edict refused.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，謝方叔等上《玉牒》、《日曆》、《會要》及《七朝經武要略》、《中興四朝志傳》，詔方叔、徐清叟、董槐等各進秩。

translations.literal: On guisi Xie Fangshu and others submitted the Jade Register, Calendar, Compendium of Institutional Regulations, Essentials of Military Affairs across Seven Reigns, and Biographical Records of the Four Reigns of the Restoration; an edict ordered Xie Fangshu, Xu Qingsou, Dong Huai, and the others each promoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Xie Fangshu and others submitted the Jade Register, the Calendar, the Compendium of Institutional Regulations, the Essentials of Military Affairs across Seven Reigns, and the Biographical Records of the Four Reigns of the Restoration; an edict ordered Xie Fangshu, Xu Qingsou, Dong Huai, and the others each promoted in rank.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，籍王惟忠家財。

translations.literal: On wuxu Wang Weizhong's family property was confiscated and inventoried.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Wang Weizhong's family property was confiscated and inventoried.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，祀明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinhai, the Bright Hall was sacrificed to and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinhai, the Bright Hall was sacrificed to and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔詣西太一宮，爲國祈祥，起居郎牟子才再疏諫而止。

translations.literal: On xinyou an edict ordered a visit to the West Grand Unity Palace to pray for the nation's good fortune; Attendant Gentleman Mou Zicai remonstrated twice by memorial and the plan was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict ordered a visit to the West Grand Unity Palace to pray for the nation's good fortune; Attendant Gentleman Mou Zicai remonstrated twice by memorial and the plan was halted.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔戒外戚毋幹請。

translations.literal: On bingyin an edict warned imperial affines against meddling in petitions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict warned imperial affines against meddling in petitions.

sentences.zh: 詔：山陰、蕭山、諸暨、會稽四縣水，其除今年田租。

translations.literal: An edict declared: the four counties of Shanyin, Xiaoshan, Zhuji, and Kuaiji had suffered flooding; this year's land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: the four counties of Shanyin, Xiaoshan, Zhuji, and Kuaiji had suffered flooding; this year's land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On dingmao Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午朔，謝方叔等進寶祐編《吏部七司續降條令》。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the new moon, gengwu, Xie Fangshu and others submitted the Baoyou edition of the Supplementary Regulations of the Seven Bureaus of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the new moon, gengwu, Xie Fangshu and others submitted the Baoyou edition of the Supplementary Regulations of the Seven Bureaus of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，皇子禥進封忠王。

translations.literal: On guiyou Prince Qi was advanced to Prince of Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Prince Qi was advanced to Prince of Zhong.

sentences.zh: 甲午，斬王惟忠於都市。

translations.literal: On jiawu Wang Weizhong was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Wang Weizhong was executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，追削余玠資政殿學士，奪余晦刑部侍郎告身。

translations.literal: On dingyou Yu Jie's title as academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance was posthumously stripped, and Yu Hui's certificate as vice minister of justice was revoked.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Yu Jie's title as academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance was posthumously stripped, and Yu Hui's certificate as vice minister of justice was revoked.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，段元鑒上隆慶堡戰功。

translations.literal: On wuxu Duan Yuanjian submitted a report on the merit of the battle at Longqing Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Duan Yuanjian submitted a report on the merit of the battle at Longqing Fort.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，日南至。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renyin, the sun reached its southern extreme.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renyin, the winter solstice arrived.

sentences.zh: 忠王冠。

translations.literal: The Prince of Zhong underwent the capping ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Zhong underwent the capping ceremony.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大元城光化舊治。

translations.literal: On dingwei the Great Yuan fortified the old seat of Guanghua.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the Great Yuan fortified the old seat of Guanghua.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，排保甲，行自實法。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengwu, baojia units were organized and the self-declaration law was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengwu, baojia units were organized and the self-declaration law was implemented.

sentences.zh: 癸未，雷。

translations.literal: On guiwei thunder sounded.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei thunder sounded.

sentences.zh: 四川苦竹隘捷至。

translations.literal: News of victory at Kuzhu Pass in Sichuan arrived.
translations.idiomatic: News of victory at Kuzhu Pass in Sichuan arrived.

sentences.zh: 甲午，隆慶部兵周榮被獲歸北，密約段元鑒入隘解圍，事覺就禽，不屈而死，馬徽、白端戰歿。

translations.literal: On jiawu Zhou Rong, a soldier of the Longqing garrison who had been captured and taken north, secretly agreed with Duan Yuanjian to enter the pass and lift the siege; when the plot was discovered he was seized and, refusing to submit, died; Ma Hui and Bai Duan fell in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zhou Rong, a soldier of the Longqing garrison who had been captured and taken north, secretly agreed with Duan Yuanjian to enter the pass and lift the siege; when the plot was discovered he was seized and, refusing to submit, died; Ma Hui and Bai Duan fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 詔四川宣撫司爲之立廟。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Sichuan pacification office to erect a temple in their honor.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Sichuan pacification office to erect a temple in their honor.

sentences.zh: 安西堡受攻五月，將士力戰解圍，居民以資糧助軍實。

translations.literal: Anxi Fort had been under attack for five months; officers and soldiers fought fiercely until the siege was lifted, and the residents supplied grain and provisions to bolster the army's stores.
translations.idiomatic: Anxi Fort had been under attack for five months; officers and soldiers fought fiercely until the siege was lifted, and the residents supplied grain and provisions to bolster the army's stores.

sentences.zh: 詔四川宣撫司具名推恩，在城人並賞一資，復租賦五年。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Sichuan pacification office to submit names for honors; all persons within the city were rewarded one rank, and taxes and levies were remitted for five years.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Sichuan pacification office to submit names for honors; all persons within the city were rewarded one rank, and taxes and levies were remitted for five years.

sentences.zh: 余玠男如孫征所認錢三千萬將足。

translations.literal: Yu Jie's son Rusun was close to completing payment of the thirty million cash he had acknowledged.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Jie's son Rusun was close to completing payment of the thirty million cash he had acknowledged.

sentences.zh: 詔如孫削三秩、勒停。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Rusun stripped of three ranks and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Rusun stripped of three ranks and dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己未，迅雷。

translations.literal: In the third year, first month of spring, on jiwei, thunder pealed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on jiwei in the first month of spring, thunder pealed.

sentences.zh: 巴州捷至。

translations.literal: News of victory at Bazhou arrived.
translations.idiomatic: News of victory at Bazhou arrived.

sentences.zh: 庚申，城均州龍山。

translations.literal: On gengshen Longshan in Junzhou was fortified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Longshan in Junzhou was fortified.

sentences.zh: 起居郎牟子才上疏言：「元夜張燈侈靡，倡優下賤，奇技獻笑，媟汙清禁，上累聖德。

translations.literal: Attendant Gentleman Mou Zicai submitted a memorial saying, "On the Lantern Festival night lamps are hung in extravagant display; actors and low performers offer strange tricks for laughter, defiling the pure precincts of the palace and reflecting poorly on the emperor's virtue."
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Gentleman Mou Zicai submitted a memorial saying, "On the Lantern Festival night lamps are hung in extravagant display; actors and low performers offer strange tricks for laughter, defiling the pure precincts of the palace and reflecting poorly on the emperor's virtue."

sentences.zh: 今因震霆示威，臣願聖明覺悟，天意可回。

translations.literal: "Now heaven has shown its warning through thunder; I pray that Your Sagely Brightness will awaken, and heaven's intent may yet be turned back."
translations.idiomatic: "Now heaven has shown its warning through thunder; I pray that Your Sagely Brightness will awaken, and heaven's intent may yet be turned back."

sentences.zh: 」帝納其言。

translations.literal: The emperor accepted his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted his words.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔宗正寺所擬宗子名，以用、宜、季、次、紹五字，續大、由、友、嗣、甫之下。

translations.literal: On renxu an edict ordered that names proposed by the Directorate of the Imperial Clan use the five characters yong, yi, ji, ci, and shao, continuing below da, you, you, si, and fu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an edict ordered that names proposed by the Directorate of the Imperial Clan use the five characters yong, yi, ji, ci, and shao, continuing below da, you, you, si, and fu.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，詔右千牛衛上將軍乃猷授蘄州防禦使，奉沂靖惠王祠事。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yihai, an edict appointed Right General of the Thousand-Ox Guard Nai You Defender of Qizhou to tend the shrine of Prince Yi Jing Hui.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yihai, an edict appointed Right General of the Thousand-Ox Guard Nai You Defender of Qizhou to tend the shrine of Prince Yi Jing Hui.

sentences.zh: 兼給事中王野言：「國家與大元本無深仇，而兵連禍結，皆原於入洛之帥輕啟兵端。

translations.literal: Concurrently Serving Gentleman Wang Ye said, "The state and Great Yuan originally bore no deep enmity, yet war has continued and disaster has accumulated, all originating from the commanders who entered Luoyang lightly opening hostilities."
translations.idiomatic: Concurrently Serving Gentleman Wang Ye said, "The state and the Great Yuan originally bore no deep enmity, yet war has continued and disaster has accumulated, all originating from the commanders who entered Luoyang lightly opening hostilities."

sentences.zh: 二三狂妄如趙楷、全子才、劉子澄輩，輕而無謀，遂致只輪不返。

translations.literal: "A few reckless men such as Zhao Kai, Quan Zicai, and Liu Zicheng, rash and without plan, caused not even a single chariot wheel to return."
translations.idiomatic: "A few reckless men such as Zhao Kai, Quan Zicai, and Liu Zicheng, rash and without plan, caused not even a single chariot wheel to return."

sentences.zh: 全子才誕妄慘毒，今乃援劉子澄例自陳改正，乞寢二人之命，罷其祠祿，以爲喪師誤國之戒。

translations.literal: "Quan Zicai is arrogant, deceitful, and cruel; now he cites Liu Zicheng's precedent to petition for correction of his own case. I beg that both men's appointments be suspended and their shrine stipends revoked, as a warning against losing armies and ruining the state."
translations.idiomatic: "Quan Zicai is arrogant, deceitful, and cruel; now he cites Liu Zicheng's precedent to petition for correction of his own case. I beg that both men's appointments be suspended and their shrine stipends revoked, as a warning against losing armies and ruining the state."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 己卯，復廣陵堡城，賈似道以圖來上。

translations.literal: On jimao Guangling Fort was restored, and Jia Sidao submitted a map of the work.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Guangling Fort was restored, and Jia Sidao submitted a map of the work.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔發緡錢二百萬給四川調度。

translations.literal: On renwu an edict released two million strings of cash for Sichuan's military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu an edict released two million strings of cash for Sichuan's military expenses.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔以告身、祠牒、新會、香、鹽，命臨安府守臣馬光祖收換兩界舊敝會子。

translations.literal: On yiyou an edict ordered that appointment certificates, shrine certificates, Xinhui paper, incense, and salt be used to collect and exchange worn huizi notes of both issues, under Lin'an Prefecture prefect Ma Guangzu.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou an edict ordered that appointment certificates, shrine certificates, Xinhui paper, incense, and salt be used to collect and exchange worn huizi notes of both issues, under Lin'an Prefecture prefect Ma Guangzu.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，詔沿邊耕屯，課入登羨，管屯田官推賞，荊襄、兩淮及山砦如之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiyou, an edict declared that where border farming colonies produced surplus revenue, the officials in charge of military colonies were to be rewarded; the same applied in Jing-Xiang, the two Huai regions, and mountain stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiyou, an edict declared that where border farming colonies produced surplus revenue, the officials in charge of military colonies were to be rewarded; the same applied in Jing-Xiang, the two Huai regions, and mountain stockades.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，邵武寇平。

translations.literal: On gengxu the bandits in Shaowu were subdued.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the bandits in Shaowu were subdued.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔自實法宜寬期限，監司、守臣其嚴戢吏奸，毋煩擾民。

translations.literal: On guichou an edict declared that the self-declaration law should be given a longer deadline; circuit commissioners and prefects were to strictly curb official corruption and not harass the people.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict declared that the self-declaration law should be given a longer deadline; circuit commissioners and prefects were to strictly curb official corruption and not harass the people.

sentences.zh: 以吳淵爲觀文殿學士、京湖制置使、知江陵府。

translations.literal: Wu Yuan was appointed academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, Jing-Hu strategic commissioner, and prefect of Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yuan was appointed academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, Jing-Hu strategic commissioner, and prefect of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 己未，雨土。

translations.literal: On jiwei dust rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei dust rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，以江萬里知福州、福建安撫使。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou, Jiang Wanli was appointed prefect of Fuzhou and Fujian pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou, Jiang Wanli was appointed prefect of Fuzhou and Fujian pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月，久雨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month rain persisted for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month rain persisted for a long time.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以監司、州郡辟書冗濫，詔申嚴禁止。

translations.literal: On dingwei, because appointment letters from circuit commissioners and prefectures had become excessive and indiscriminate, an edict strictly forbade the practice.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, because appointment letters from circuit commissioners and prefectures had become excessive and indiscriminate, an edict strictly forbade the practice.

sentences.zh: 己酉，李性傳薨。

translations.literal: On jiyou Li Xingchuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Li Xingchuan died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太陰入畢。

translations.literal: On xinyou the Moon entered the Net mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Moon entered the Net constellation.

sentences.zh: 嘉定大雨、雹，與敘南同日地震。

translations.literal: In Jiading there was heavy rain and hail; on the same day an earthquake struck Xunan.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading was hit by heavy rain and hail, and an earthquake struck Xunan the same day.

sentences.zh: 浙西大水。

translations.literal: Western Zhe suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Western Zhe was inundated by major floods.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，大風。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on xinwei, strong wind.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinwei, gale-force winds blew.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太陰入氐。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Moon entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Moon entered the Root constellation.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，李全子松壽葺舊海城，窺海道，賈似道調兵敗之，敕書獎諭，趣上立功等第、姓名推賞。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Li Quan's son Songsou repaired the old maritime fortress and eyed the sea routes; Jia Sidao mobilized troops and defeated him; an imperial letter praised and admonished him, ordering prompt submission of merit ranks, grades, and names for reward.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Quan's son Songsou rebuilt the old coastal fort and probed the sea lanes; Jia Sidao raised troops and defeated him; an imperial commendation was sent, and meritorious officers were ordered to submit their names and merit ranks promptly for reward.

sentences.zh: 戊子，洪天錫劾內官盧允叔、董宋臣，疏不報，竟去，詔遷太常少卿。

translations.literal: On wuzi Hong Tiansi impeached inner officials Lu Yunshu and Dong Songchen; the memorial received no response, and he finally departed; an edict transferred him to vice director of the Directorate of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Hong Tiansi impeached the inner officials Lu Yunshu and Dong Songchen; when the memorial went unanswered he eventually resigned, and was then ordered transferred to vice director of the Directorate of Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，王野以御史胡大昌言罷給事中，依舊端明殿學士、提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: On xinmao Wang Ye was removed from the post of concurrently serving gentleman on the word of censor Hu Dachang, continuing as academician of the Duanming Hall and superintendent of the Cave of Heaven Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Wang Ye was dismissed as concurrently serving gentleman at the urging of censor Hu Dachang, but retained his posts as academician of the Duanming Hall and superintendent of the Cave of Heaven Abbey.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，太陰入氐。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on xinchou, the Moon entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinchou, the Moon entered the Root constellation.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以呂文德知鄂州，節制鼎、澧、辰、沅、靖五州。

translations.literal: On guichou Lü Wende was made prefect of E Prefecture, controlling the five prefectures of Ding, Li, Chen, Yuan, and Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Lü Wende was appointed prefect of E Prefecture with oversight of Ding, Li, Chen, Yuan, and Jing prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，謝方叔、徐清叟以御史朱應元言罷。

translations.literal: On bingchen Xie Fangshu and Xu Qingsou were dismissed on the word of censor Zhu Yuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Xie Fangshu and Xu Qingsou were dismissed at the urging of censor Zhu Yuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: On xinyou a meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou a meteor as large as the Great White Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 詔三省樞府機政，令董槐、程元鳳輪日判事取旨。

translations.literal: An edict on the routine affairs of the Three Departments and the Military Bureau ordered Dong Huai and Cheng Yuanfeng to adjudicate matters in daily rotation and receive instructions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict on routine business at the Three Departments and Military Bureau directed Dong Huai and Cheng Yuanfeng to take turns handling affairs and receiving imperial decisions.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以謝方叔爲觀文殿大學士、提舉臨安府洞霄宮。

translations.literal: On renxu Xie Fangshu was made grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and superintendent of the Cave of Heaven Abbey in Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Xie Fangshu was appointed grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and superintendent of the Cave of Heaven Abbey in Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午朔，雷。

translations.literal: On the new moon jiawu of the ninth month, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the ninth month, jiawu, there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以徐清叟爲資政殿學士、提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: On bingwu Xu Qingsou was made academician of the Hall for Promoting Governance and superintendent of the Cave of Heaven Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Xu Qingsou was appointed academician of the Hall for Promoting Governance and superintendent of the Cave of Heaven Abbey.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，陳顯伯兼資善堂翊善，皮龍榮兼資善堂贊讀。

translations.literal: On bingchen Chen Xianbo was additionally made assisting tutor of the Hall for Nourishing Goodness, and Pi Longrong was additionally made reader of the Hall for Nourishing Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Chen Xianbo was additionally appointed assisting tutor of the Hall for Nourishing Goodness, and Pi Longrong was additionally appointed reader of the same hall.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，權中書舍人陳大方言：「劉子澄端平入洛之師，賈勇贊決，北兵方入唐州界，子澄巳率先遁逃，一敗塗地，二十年來，爲國家患者，皆原於此，宜投之四裔。

translations.literal: On renxu Acting Drafting Official Chen Dafang said: "Liu Zicheng was among the army that marched into Luoyang in the Duanping era, eagerly urging the decision; when northern troops had just entered Tang Prefecture's borders, Zicheng had already fled first—a total defeat; for twenty years the nation's afflictions have all originated here; he should be exiled to the four barbarian regions.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Acting Drafting Official Chen Dafang said: "Liu Zicheng was among the Duanping army that marched into Luoyang and eagerly urged the venture forward; when northern troops had scarcely entered Tang Prefecture, Zicheng was already first to flee, ending in utter disaster; the state's troubles over the past twenty years all stem from this, and he should be banished to the farthest frontier."

sentences.zh: 」詔罷子澄祠祿。

translations.literal: An edict removed Zicheng's stipendary office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped Liu Zicheng of his stipendary office.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on jiaxu, the Great White Star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiaxu, the Great White Star appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，有流星出自畢。

translations.literal: On dingchou a meteor issued from the Net mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou a meteor appeared from the Net constellation.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳，熒惑犯太微垣上相星。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on dingsi, Mars transgressed the Upper Chancellor star of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingsi, Mars transgressed the Upper Chancellor star in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，嗣濮王善奐薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on yichou, Heir of the Prince of Pu Shan Huan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yichou, Shan Huan, heir prince of Pu, died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，少傅、節度使與歡薨，贈少師，追封奉化郡王。

translations.literal: On bingzi Junior Tutor and military commissioner Yu Huan died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of the Commandery of Fenghua.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Junior Tutor and military commissioner Yu Huan died; he was posthumously promoted to Junior Preceptor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Fenghua commandery.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙未，詔謝方叔奪職罷祠，謝修削三秩勒停。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, first month of spring, on yiwei, an edict stripped Xie Fangshu of his office and stipend; Xie was reduced three ranks and ordered to cease service.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on yiwei in the first month of spring, an edict stripped Xie Fangshu of his office and stipendary post; he was demoted three ranks and suspended from service.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太陰犯歲星。

translations.literal: On yisi the Moon transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Moon transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太陰犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On jiyou the Moon transgressed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the Moon transgressed Mars.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以吳淵爲京湖制置使兼夔路策應使，軍馬急切，便宜行事。

translations.literal: On xinhai Wu Yuan was made Jing-Hu strategic commissioner and concurrent Chongqing route response commissioner; with troops and horses urgent, he was permitted to act at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Wu Yuan was appointed Jing-Hu strategic commissioner and concurrent Chongqing route response commissioner; given the pressing military situation, he was authorized to act at discretion.

sentences.zh: 庚申，蜀閫奏捷。

translations.literal: On gengshen the Sichuan frontier reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the Sichuan frontier reported a military victory.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔史嵩之觀文殿大學士，依前金紫光祿大夫、永國公致仕。

translations.literal: On xinyou an edict appointed Shi Songzhi grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, continuing as former Grand Master of the Golden Purple Light and retired as Duke of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict appointed Shi Songzhi grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, retaining his rank as Grand Master of the Golden Purple Light and his retirement as Duke of Yong.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，雨雹。

translations.literal: In the second month on wuchen, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuchen, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔襲封衍聖公孫孔洙添差通判吉州，不厘務。

translations.literal: On bingzi an edict ordered Kong Zhu, grandson of the hereditary Duke of Continuing Sage, given an additional assignment as vice prefect of Ji Prefecture, without administrative duties.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict appointed Kong Zhu, grandson of the hereditary Duke of Continuing Sage, to an additional post as vice prefect of Ji Prefecture without regular administrative duties.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，以少師、嗣榮王與芮爲太傅。

translations.literal: In the third month on renyin, Junior Preceptor and Heir Prince of Rong Yu Rui was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renyin, Junior Preceptor and heir prince of Rong Yu Rui was appointed Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，日暈周匝。

translations.literal: On yimao a complete solar halo appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the sun was ringed by a complete halo.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，帝制《字民訓》賜改秩親民官。

translations.literal: On bingchen the Emperor composed "Instruction in Governing the People" and bestowed it upon officials receiving rank changes who served close to the people.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the emperor composed Instruction in Governing the People and granted it to officials receiving rank changes who directly governed the people.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，月暈周匝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on gengwu, a complete lunar halo appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengwu, the moon was ringed by a complete halo.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以程元鳳參知政事；

translations.literal: On guiwei Cheng Yuanfeng was made associate director of the Department of State Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Cheng Yuanfeng was appointed associate director of the Department of State Affairs;

sentences.zh: 蔡抗同知樞密院事；

translations.literal: Cai Kang vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Cai Kang vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs;

sentences.zh: 賈似道參知政事，職任依舊；

translations.literal: Jia Sidao associate director of the Department of State Affairs, duties unchanged;
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao associate director of the Department of State Affairs, retaining his duties;

sentences.zh: 李曾伯資政殿大學士、福建安撫使；

translations.literal: Li Zengbo grand academician of the Hall for Promoting Governance and Fujian pacification commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Li Zengbo grand academician of the Hall for Promoting Governance and Fujian pacification commissioner;

sentences.zh: 吳淵進二秩，職任依舊；

translations.literal: Wu Yuan advanced two ranks, duties unchanged;
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yuan advanced two ranks, retaining his duties;

sentences.zh: 吳潛沿海制置使、判慶元府；

translations.literal: Wu Qian coastal strategic commissioner and acting prefect of Qingyuan;
translations.idiomatic: Wu Qian coastal strategic commissioner and acting prefect of Qingyuan;

sentences.zh: 馬光祖煥章閣直學士，職任依舊。

translations.literal: Ma Guangzu direct academician of the Huanzhang Pavilion, duties unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Guangzu direct academician of the Huanzhang Pavilion, retaining his duties.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，孫夢觀兼資善堂贊讀，章鑒兼資善堂直講。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on jiawu, Sun Mengguan was additionally made reader of the Hall for Nourishing Goodness, and Zhang Jian was additionally made lecturer of the Hall for Nourishing Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiawu, Sun Mengguan was additionally appointed reader of the Hall for Nourishing Goodness, and Zhang Jian was additionally appointed lecturer of the same hall.

sentences.zh: 先聖五十代孫孔元龍賜迪功郎，授初品官。

translations.literal: Kong Yuanlong, fiftieth-generation descendant of the First Sage, was granted Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement and given entry-level office.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Yuanlong, fiftieth-generation descendant of the First Sage, was granted Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement and appointed to entry-level office.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，羅氏鬼國遣報思、播言：大元兵屯大理國，取道西南，將大入邊。

translations.literal: On jiachen envoys from the Lu clan Ghost State of Baosi and Bo reported: Great Yuan troops were encamped in Dali and, taking the southwestern route, would soon invade the border in force.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen envoys from the Lu clan Ghost State reported from Baosi and Bo that Great Yuan troops were encamped in Dali and, advancing by the southwestern route, would soon invade the border in force.

sentences.zh: 詔以銀萬兩，使思、播結約羅鬼爲援。

translations.literal: An edict granted ten thousand taels of silver and ordered Baosi and Bo to treaty with the Lu Ghost as ally.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted ten thousand taels of silver and ordered Baosi and Bo to conclude an alliance with the Lu Ghost State.

sentences.zh: 徐清叟奪資政殿大學士、罷祠祿，王野奪端明殿學士罷祠，仍褫執政恩數。

translations.literal: Xu Qingsou was stripped of grand academician of the Hall for Promoting Governance and his stipend; Wang Ye was stripped of Duanming Hall academician and stipend, and also deprived of chief-minister perquisites.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Qingsou was stripped of his grand academician title at the Hall for Promoting Governance and his stipend; Wang Ye was stripped of his Duanming Hall academician title and stipend, and also deprived of chief-minister perquisites.

sentences.zh: 丁未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On dingwei the Great White Star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the Great White Star appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 詔申嚴老鼠隘防戍。

translations.literal: An edict strictly ordered defense garrison at Laoshu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: An edict strictly reinforced the garrison at Laoshu Pass.

sentences.zh: 襄、樊閫臣奏捷。

translations.literal: The Xiang and Fan frontiers reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiang and Fan frontier commanders reported victory.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賜禮部進士文天祥以下六百一人及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On jiayin the Ministry of Rites granted passage of the examinations and entry into service in varying degrees to the presented scholar Wen Tianxiang and six hundred one others.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the Ministry of Rites granted the presented scholar Wen Tianxiang and six hundred one others passage of the examinations and entry into service in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，朱禩孫太府寺簿、知瀘州兼潼川路安撫，任責瀘、敘、長寧邊防。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on jiaxu Zhu Disun was made secretary of the Palace Treasury Office and prefect of Lu Prefecture, concurrent Tongchuan circuit pacification commissioner, charged with the border defense of Lu, Xu, and Changning.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, Zhu Disun was appointed secretary of the Palace Treasury Office and prefect of Lu Prefecture, concurrent Tongchuan circuit pacification commissioner, with responsibility for the border defense of Lu, Xu, and Changning.

sentences.zh: 浙江堤成。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang dikes were completed.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang dikes were finished.

sentences.zh: 癸未，董槐罷。

translations.literal: On guiwei Dong Huai was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Dong Huai was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 台臣丁大全既累疏擊之，辭極詆毀，且以台牒役隅兵夜半迫槐出關，物論殊駭；

translations.literal: Censor Ding Daquan had repeatedly memorialized attacking him, his language extremely slanderous, and moreover used a censorial warrant to employ corner troops at midnight to force Huai out of the pass; public opinion was greatly shocked;
translations.idiomatic: Censor Ding Daquan had repeatedly memorialized against him in language of extreme slander, and moreover used a censorial warrant to press corner troops into service at midnight to drive Huai out of the pass; public opinion was greatly shocked;

sentences.zh: 三學生屢上書以爲言，詔以槐爲觀文殿大學士、提舉臨安府洞霄宮。

translations.literal: students of the three academies repeatedly submitted memorials on the matter; an edict made Huai grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and superintendent of the Cave of Heaven Abbey in Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: students of the three academies repeatedly submitted memorials on the matter; an edict appointed Huai grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and superintendent of the Cave of Heaven Abbey in Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔程元鳳、蔡抗可輪日判事，軍國重務取旨。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Cheng Yuanfeng and Cai Kang to adjudicate in daily rotation, taking instructions on weighty military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed Cheng Yuanfeng and Cai Kang to take turns handling affairs and to seek imperial decisions on weighty military and state matters.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太白入井。

translations.literal: On dinghai the Great White Star entered the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Great White Star entered the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，知敘州史俊調舟師與大元兵戰，凡十三合，詔俊官三轉，仍帶閣門行宣贊舍人。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on jiayin, Xu Prefecture prefect Shi Jun mobilized naval forces to fight Great Yuan troops in thirteen engagements; an edict advanced Jun three ranks and additionally granted him attendant gateway envoy for proclamation.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiayin, Xu Prefecture prefect Shi Jun mobilized naval forces and fought Great Yuan troops in thirteen engagements; an edict advanced Jun three ranks and additionally granted him attendant gateway envoy for proclamation.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以程元鳳爲右丞相兼樞密使，蔡抗參知政事，張磻端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On yimao Cheng Yuanfeng was made Right Chancellor and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs; Cai Kang associate director of the Department of State Affairs; Zhang Pan academician of the Duanming Hall and associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Cheng Yuanfeng was appointed Right Chancellor and concurrent commissioner of military affairs; Cai Kang associate director of the Department of State Affairs; and Zhang Pan academician of the Duanming Hall and associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，程元鳳上疏言正心、待臣、進賢、愛民、備邊、守法、謹微、審令八事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on jiazi Cheng Yuanfeng submitted a memorial discussing eight matters: rectifying the heart, treating ministers, advancing the worthy, loving the people, preparing the border, upholding law, exercising caution in minutiae, and scrutinizing commands.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiazi, Cheng Yuanfeng submitted a memorial on eight matters: rectifying the heart, treating ministers, advancing the worthy, loving the people, preparing the border, upholding law, exercising caution in minutiae, and scrutinizing commands.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，西南蕃呂告蠻目寧名天兄弟慕義與烏蘇蠻合力爲國禦難，詔各補承信郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on renchen the southwestern tribesmen Lü Gao Man chieftains Ning Mingtian and his brothers, admiring righteousness, joined forces with the Wusu tribes to defend the state in crisis; an edict appointed each Gentleman for Trustworthiness.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renchen, the Lü Gao Man chieftains Ning Mingtian and his brothers, drawn by righteousness, joined forces with the Wusu tribes to defend the state in crisis; an edict appointed each Gentleman for Trustworthiness.

sentences.zh: 丙申，知邕州程芾以貪暴，詔削二秩罷之。

translations.literal: On bingshen Cheng Fei, prefect of Yong Prefecture, on account of greed and cruelty, was ordered stripped of two ranks and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Cheng Fei, prefect of Yong Prefecture, was stripped of two ranks and dismissed for greed and cruelty.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，監察御史朱熠言：「境土蹙而賦斂日繁，官吏增而調度日廣。

translations.literal: On jiayin Supervising Censor Zhu Yi said: "The realm's territory has shrunk while tax levies grow daily; officials increase while fiscal outlays expand daily.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Supervising Censor Zhu Yi said: "The realm's territory has shrunk while tax levies grow daily; officials increase while fiscal outlays expand daily.

sentences.zh: 景德、慶歷時，以三百二十餘郡之財賦，供一萬餘員之奉祿；

translations.literal: In the Jingde and Qingli eras, the revenues of more than three hundred twenty prefectures supplied the stipends of more than ten thousand officers;
translations.idiomatic: In the Jingde and Qingli eras, the revenues of more than three hundred twenty prefectures supplied the stipends of more than ten thousand officers;

sentences.zh: 今日以一百餘郡之事力，贍二萬四千餘員之冗官。

translations.literal: today the resources of more than one hundred prefectures must support more than twenty-four thousand superfluous officials.
translations.idiomatic: today the resources of little more than one hundred prefectures must support more than twenty-four thousand superfluous officials.

sentences.zh: 邊郡則有科降支移，內地則欠經常納解。

translations.literal: In border prefectures there are additional assessments and tax transfers; in inner prefectures regular tax deliveries fall short.
translations.idiomatic: In border prefectures there are additional assessments and tax transfers, while inner prefectures fall short on regular tax deliveries.

sentences.zh: 欲寬民力，必汰冗員。

translations.literal: If one wishes to ease the people's burden, superfluous personnel must be cut.
translations.idiomatic: To ease the people's burden, superfluous personnel must be cut.

sentences.zh: 」帝納焉。

translations.literal: The Emperor accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted the proposal.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，太陰犯鬥。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on renxu, the Moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renxu, the Moon transgressed the Dipper constellation.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子朔，荊、襄閫臣以功狀來上，詔推賞將士。

translations.literal: On the new moon wuzi of the eleventh month, Jing and Xiang frontier commanders submitted battle achievements; an edict ordered rewards for officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eleventh month, wuzi, Jing and Xiang frontier commanders submitted battle achievements; an edict ordered rewards for officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，京湖繼上戰功。

translations.literal: On wuxu Jing-Hu subsequently submitted military achievements.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Jing-Hu subsequently submitted reports of military achievements.

sentences.zh: 詔：「蜀罹兵革，吾民重困，所當勞來撫摩，使之樂業。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Sichuan has suffered warfare; our people are deeply afflicted; they should be encouraged to return and soothed, so that they may settle and prosper.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Sichuan has suffered warfare; our people are deeply afflicted; they should be encouraged to return and soothed so that they may settle and prosper.

sentences.zh: 比聞官吏乃肆誅求，殊失培植邦本之意。

translations.literal: Recently it is heard that officials wildly extort, greatly failing the intent of nurturing the state's foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Yet it is now heard that officials wildly extort, greatly failing the intent of nurturing the state's foundation.

sentences.zh: 自今四川制司戒飭屬郡，違者罪無赦，御史台其嚴覺察。

translations.literal: From now on the Sichuan commissioner shall admonish subordinate prefectures; violators shall be punished without pardon; the Censorate shall strictly oversee.
translations.idiomatic: From now on the Sichuan commissioner shall admonish subordinate prefectures; violators shall be punished without pardon, and the Censorate shall strictly oversee.

sentences.zh: 」乙巳，以監察御史吳衍、翁應弼劾太學武學生劉黻等八人不率，詔拘管江西、湖南州軍，宗學生與亻匈等七人並削籍，拘管外宗正司。

translations.literal: On yisi, on the impeachment of supervising censors Wu Yan and Weng Yingbi, eight Imperial University and martial students including Liu Fu were unruly; an edict ordered them confined under supervision in Jiangxi and Hunan prefectures and armies; seven imperial clan students including Yu Xun were struck from the rolls and confined under supervision at the Outer Imperial Clan Office.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, on the impeachment of supervising censors Wu Yan and Weng Yingbi, eight Imperial University and martial students including Liu Fu were found unruly; an edict ordered them confined under supervision in Jiangxi and Hunan prefectures and armies; seven imperial clan students including Yu Xun were struck from the rolls and confined under supervision at the Outer Imperial Clan Office.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以張磻同知樞密院事，丁大全端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事，馬天驥端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On guichou Zhang Pan was made vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Ding Daquan academician of the Duanming Hall and associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Ma Tianji academician of the Duanming Hall and concurrent associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Zhang Pan was appointed vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Ding Daquan academician of the Duanming Hall and associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; and Ma Tianji academician of the Duanming Hall and concurrent associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔戒群臣洗心飭行，毋縱於貨賄，其或不悛，舉行淳熙成法。

translations.literal: An edict admonished all officials to cleanse their hearts and discipline their conduct, not indulging in bribes; those who did not reform would face the established law of the Chunxi era.
translations.idiomatic: An edict admonished all officials to cleanse their hearts and discipline their conduct and not indulge in bribes; those who did not reform would face the established law of the Chunxi era.

sentences.zh: 又開國以來勳臣之裔，有能世濟其美而不世其祿者，所在州郡以聞。

translations.literal: Further, among descendants of meritorious ministers since the founding, those able to pass down their virtue generation after generation yet not inherit stipends were to be reported by their prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Further, among descendants of meritorious ministers since the founding, those who passed down their virtue generation after generation yet did not inherit stipends were to be reported by their prefectures.

sentences.zh: 參知政事蔡抗輒擅去國，勉留不返，詔授職予祠，尋以林存言，寢其命。

translations.literal: Associate Director Cai Kang abruptly left the capital without authorization; though urged to stay he did not return; an edict granted him office with stipend only; soon on Lin Cun's memorial the order was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Associate Director Cai Kang abruptly left the capital without authorization; though urged to stay he did not return; an edict granted him office with stipend only, but soon on Lin Cun's memorial the order was suspended.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午朔，熒惑犯填星。

translations.literal: On the new moon wuwu of the twelfth month, Mars transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month, wuwu, Mars transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大元城棗陽。

translations.literal: On gengshen the Great Yuan fortified Zaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the Great Yuan fortified Zaoyang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以張磻兼參知政事。

translations.literal: On yichou Zhang Pan was additionally made associate director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zhang Pan was additionally appointed associate director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，獎諭荊閫吳淵，其有功將士，趣上姓名、等第推賞。

translations.literal: On jiaxu an imperial commendation praised Jing frontier commander Wu Yuan; meritorious officers and soldiers were ordered to submit names and merit ranks promptly for reward.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an imperial commendation praised Jing frontier commander Wu Yuan; meritorious officers and soldiers were ordered to submit their names and merit ranks promptly for reward.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，四川嘉定上戰功。

translations.literal: In the second month on wuwu, Sichuan's Jiading reported military achievements.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuwu, Jiading in Sichuan reported military achievements.

sentences.zh: 以賈似道爲兩淮安撫使。

translations.literal: Jia Sidao was made Huai pacification commissioner for both circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao was appointed pacification commissioner for both Huai circuits.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命趙葵兼湖廣總領財賦，余晦淮西總領財賦。

translations.literal: On xinyou Zhao Kui was ordered concurrent Hu-Guang fiscal commissioner; Yu Hui Huaixi fiscal commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Zhao Kui was ordered to serve concurrently as Hu-Guang fiscal commissioner, and Yu Hui as Huaixi fiscal commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，築思州三隘。

translations.literal: On renxu three passes of Si Prefecture were fortified.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu three passes in Si Prefecture were fortified.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，布衣余一飛、高杞陳襄陽備禦策，詔命趙葵行之。

translations.literal: On dingchou commoners Yu Yifei and Gao Qi presented strategies for Xiangyang's defense; an edict ordered Zhao Kui to implement them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou commoners Yu Yifei and Gao Qi presented strategies for defending Xiangyang; an edict ordered Zhao Kui to implement them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，詔襄陽安撫高達以白河戰功，轉行右武大夫、帶遙郡防禦使；

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on dingmao an edict ordered Xiangyang pacification commissioner Gao Da, for merit at the White River battle, transferred to Right Martial Grandee and granted acting remote-prefecture defense commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingmao, an edict ordered Xiangyang pacification commissioner Gao Da, for merit at the White River battle, transferred to Right Martial Grandee and granted acting remote-prefecture defense commissioner;

sentences.zh: 王登以沮河督戰官一轉，升直秘閣，并職任依舊。

translations.literal: Wang Deng for supervising battle at the Zu River, advanced one rank, promoted to direct secretariat, duties unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Deng, for supervising battle at the Zu River, was advanced one rank, promoted to direct secretariat, and retained his duties.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大元兵攻苦竹隘，詔京湖調兵應援。

translations.literal: On jimao Great Yuan troops attacked Kuchu Pass; an edict ordered Jing-Hu to mobilize troops for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Great Yuan troops attacked Kuchu Pass; an edict ordered Jing-Hu to mobilize troops to reinforce the defense.

sentences.zh: 閏四月己丑，程元鳯等進《玉牒》、《日曆》、《會要》、《經武要略》、及《中興四朝志傳》。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month on jichou Cheng Yuanfeng and others presented the Jade Genealogy, Calendar, Imperial Collections, Essentials of Military Classics, and Annals and Biographies of the Four Restoration Reigns.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, on jichou, Cheng Yuanfeng and others presented the Jade Genealogy, the Calendar, the Imperial Collections, the Essentials of Military Classics, and the Annals and Biographies of the Four Restoration Reigns.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔徐敏子嚴防邕、宜。

translations.literal: On jiawu an edict ordered Xu Minzi to strictly defend Yong and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict ordered Xu Minzi to strictly defend Yong and Yi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以吕文德知靖州，職任依舊。

translations.literal: On jiyou Lü Wende was made prefect of Jing Prefecture, duties unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Lü Wende was appointed prefect of Jing Prefecture, retaining his duties.

sentences.zh: 祈雨。

translations.literal: Prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: The court offered prayers for rain.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，雨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on gengshen it rained.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengshen, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，城荊山，置懷遠軍荊山縣。

translations.literal: On dingmao Jingshan was walled; Huaiyuan Army and Jingshan County were established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Jingshan was fortified; Huaiyuan Army and Jingshan County were established.

sentences.zh: 詔賈似道官兩轉。

translations.literal: An edict advanced Jia Sidao two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: An edict advanced Jia Sidao two ranks in office.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔京湖、沿江、海道嚴備舟師防遏。

translations.literal: On wuyin an edict ordered Jing-Hu, the Yangzi coast, and maritime routes to strictly prepare naval forces for defense and interdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict ordered Jing-Hu, the Yangzi coast, and the maritime routes to ready their naval forces for strict defense and interdiction.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，復劍門壘，賞蒲擇之官兩轉，朱禩孫、蒲黼、楊大淵、韓勇各官四轉。

translations.literal: On xinsi Jianmen fortress was recovered; Pu Zezhi was rewarded with two ranks in office; Zhu Suisun, Pu Fu, Yang Dayuan, and Han Yong each advanced four ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Jianmen fortress was recovered; Pu Zezhi was promoted two ranks, and Zhu Suisun, Pu Fu, Yang Dayuan, and Han Yong were each promoted four ranks.

sentences.zh: 壬午，夏貴正任吉州刺史、帶御器械、鎮江駐紮都統制、知懷遠軍。

translations.literal: On renwu Xia Gui was formally appointed prefect of Ji Prefecture, bearer of Imperial Arms, overall controller garrisoned at Zhenjiang, and military commander of Huaiyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Xia Gui was formally appointed prefect of Ji Prefecture, bearer of Imperial Arms, overall controller garrisoned at Zhenjiang, and commander of Huaiyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，太白、歲星合於翼。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on bingxu, Venus and Jupiter conjoined in the Wings mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingxu, Venus and Jupiter conjoined in the Wings constellation.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太陰入氐。

translations.literal: On xinmao the Moon entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Moon entered the Root constellation.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，祈雨。

translations.literal: On dingyou prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the court offered prayers for rain.

sentences.zh: 馬天驥以台臣言罷，詔依舊端明殿學士、提舉臨安洞霄宮。

translations.literal: Ma Tianji was dismissed on censorial memorial; an edict granted him continuing status as academician of the Duanming Hall and superintendent of Lin'an's Tongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Tianji was dismissed on a censorial memorial; an edict restored him as academician of the Duanming Hall and superintendent of Lin'an's Tongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，祈雨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on bingchen, prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, the court offered prayers for rain.

sentences.zh: 戊午，雨。

translations.literal: On wuwu it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu rain fell.

sentences.zh: 己未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jiwei the Great White Star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，有流星大如桃。

translations.literal: On dingmao a meteor as large as a peach appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao a meteor as large as a peach was seen.

sentences.zh: 丙子，太陰入井。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Moon entered the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Moon entered the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子朔，詔今後台臣遷他職，輒出關，以違制論，仍著爲令。

translations.literal: On the new moon renzi of the ninth month, an edict ordered that henceforth when censorial officials transferred to other posts they were not to leave the capital without authorization, on pain of violation of regulations, and this was recorded as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the ninth month, renzi, an edict declared that henceforth when censorial officials moved to other posts they must not leave the capital without authorization, on penalty of violating regulations; the rule was codified.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，祀明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinyou the Bright Hall was sacrificed to and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Bright Hall was sacrificed to and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，張磻薨，贈少師。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on gengyin, Zhang Pan died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengyin, Zhang Pan died and was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，雷。

translations.literal: On guisi thunder sounded.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 甲午，虹見。

translations.literal: On jiawu a rainbow appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu a rainbow was seen.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以林存簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On dingyou Lin Cun was made associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Lin Cun was appointed associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔皇子忠王禥授鎮南、遂安軍節度使，皇女進封升國公主。

translations.literal: On gengzi an edict granted Prince Zhong Wang Qi the military governorship of Zhennan and Sui'an Armies; an imperial daughter was further enfeoffed as Princess Shengguo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict appointed Prince Zhong Wang Qi military governor of Zhennan and Sui'an Armies, and an imperial daughter was further enfeoffed as Princess Shengguo.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，李曾伯兼節制廣南，任責邊防。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on bingchen, Li Zengbo was additionally made controller of Guangnan, charged with frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingchen, Li Zengbo was additionally appointed controller of Guangnan and charged with frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，獎諭安南國，賜金器幣、香茗。

translations.literal: On yichou an imperial commendation praised Annam; gold vessels, silks, and fragrant tea were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou an imperial commendation was sent to Annam, with gifts of gold vessels, silks, and fragrant tea.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔京湖帥臣，黃平、清浪、平溪分置屯戍。

translations.literal: On yihai an edict ordered Jing-Hu commanders to establish separate garrisons at Huangping, Qinglang, and Pingxi.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict ordered the Jing-Hu commander to establish separate garrisons at Huangping, Qinglang, and Pingxi.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔三邊郡縣官毋擅離職守，諸制帥臣其嚴糾察。

translations.literal: On gengchen an edict ordered frontier prefectures and counties' officials not to leave their posts without authorization; all military commissioners were to strictly investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an edict ordered officials in the three frontiers not to leave their posts without authorization, and commanded the military commissioners to strictly enforce this.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，李曾伯依舊資政殿學士、湖南安撫使兼廣南制置使，移司靜江府。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on renwu, Li Zengbo continuing as academician of the Hall for Promoting Governance, Hunan pacification commissioner, and concurrent Guangnan commissioner, moved headquarters to Jingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renwu, Li Zengbo was reappointed academician of the Hall for Promoting Governance, Hunan pacification commissioner, and concurrent Guangnan commissioner, and moved his headquarters to Jingjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，熒惑入氐。

translations.literal: On dingwei Mars entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Mars entered the Root constellation.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛亥朔，以丁大全參知政事兼同知樞密院事，林存兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, first month of spring, on the new moon xinhai, Ding Daquan was made associate director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Lin Cun was additionally made acting associate director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the new moon of the first month of spring, xinhai, Ding Daquan was appointed associate director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Lin Cun was additionally appointed acting associate director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔出封樁庫銀萬兩付蜀閫。

translations.literal: On guihai an edict ordered ten thousand taels of silver disbursed from the sealed reserve treasury to the Sichuan frontier command.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict ordered ten thousand taels of silver released from the sealed reserve treasury and sent to the Sichuan frontier command.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔授成穆皇后弟太師郭師禹孫善庸承務郎，仍免銓注差。

translations.literal: On xinwei an edict granted Chengyu Empress's younger brother's grandson, Senior Preceptor Guo Shiyu's grandson Shanyong, Assistant Gentleman for Service, exempting him from the roster selection assignment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei an edict appointed Shanyong, grandson of Senior Preceptor Guo Shiyu, younger brother of Empress Chengyu, as Assistant Gentleman for Service, exempting him from the roster selection assignment.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，罷李曾伯廣西經略，以廣南制置大使兼知靜江府。

translations.literal: On guiyou Li Zengbo was removed as Guangxi frontier commissioner; he was made Guangnan grand commissioner and concurrent prefect of Jingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Zengbo was relieved as Guangxi frontier commissioner and appointed Guangnan grand commissioner and concurrent prefect of Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 其經略司官屬，改充制司官屬。

translations.literal: The staff of his frontier commissioner's office were reassigned as staff of the strategic commissioner's office.
translations.idiomatic: The staff of his frontier commissioner's office were reassigned to the strategic commissioner's office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔樞密院編修官呂逢年詣蜀閫，趣辦關隘、屯柵、糧餉，相度黃平、思、播諸處險要緩急事宜，具工役以聞。

translations.literal: On jiaxu an edict ordered Bureau of Military Affairs compiler Lü Fengnian to proceed to the Sichuan frontier command to expedite passes, stockades, and rations, assess the strategic priorities at Huangping, Si, Bo, and other places, and report the required labor in memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an edict ordered Bureau of Military Affairs compiler Lü Fengnian to proceed to the Sichuan frontier command to expedite passes, stockades, and grain supplies, assess strategic priorities at Huangping, Si, Bo, and other places, and report the required labor in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，雷。

translations.literal: On wuyin thunder sounded.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳朔，以馬光祖爲端明殿學士、京湖制置使、知江陵府，兼夔路策應、湖廣總領財賦屯田事。

translations.literal: On the new moon xinsi of the second month, Ma Guangzu was made academician of the Duanming Hall, Jing-Hu strategic commissioner, and prefect of Jiangling, concurrently Chongqing route response commissioner and overall fiscal and military colony affairs of Hu-Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the second month, xinsi, Ma Guangzu was appointed academician of the Duanming Hall, Jing-Hu strategic commissioner, and prefect of Jiangling, and concurrently assigned Chongqing route response and overall fiscal and military colony affairs in Hu-Guang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，雨土。

translations.literal: On renchen dust rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen dust rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥朔，祈雨。

translations.literal: On the new moon xinhai of the third month, prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the third month, xinhai, the court offered prayers for rain.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，馬光祖請以呂文德、王鑒、王登、汪立信等充制司參議官及辟制司準備差使等官，詔光祖開閫之初，姑從所請。
