translations.literal: On bingchen Ma Guangzu requested that Lü Wende, Wang Jian, Wang Deng, Wang Lixin, and others serve as strategic commissioner consultative officers and provisional aides of the strategic commissioner's office; an edict stated that at the outset of Ma Guangzu's opening the command headquarters, his request was temporarily granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Ma Guangzu requested that Lü Wende, Wang Jian, Wang Deng, Wang Lixin, and others serve as consultative officers and provisional aides of the strategic commissioner's office; an edict stated that at the outset of Ma Guangzu's opening his command headquarters, the request was temporarily granted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以馬光祖兼荊湖北路安撫使。

translations.literal: On wuchen Ma Guangzu was additionally made Jing-Hubei circuit pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Ma Guangzu was additionally appointed Jing-Hubei circuit pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，熒惑退入氐。

translations.literal: On gengwu Mars withdrew and re-entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Mars withdrew and re-entered the Root constellation.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔湖北提點刑獄文復之移司江陵，兼京湖制司參議官。

translations.literal: On jiaxu an edict ordered Hubei judicial intendant Wen Fuzhi to move headquarters to Jiangling and additionally serve as Jing-Hu strategic commission consultative officer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an edict ordered Hubei judicial intendant Wen Fuzhi to move his headquarters to Jiangling and additionally serve as a Jing-Hu strategic commission consultative officer.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰朔，詔：自冬徂春，天久不雨，民失東作。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon gengchen, an edict stated: from winter to spring the heavens long withheld rain and the people missed the spring planting.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon gengchen, an edict stated that from winter to spring rain had long been absent and the people had missed their spring planting.

sentences.zh: 自四月一日始，避殿減膳，仰答譴告。

translations.literal: From the first day of the fourth month, the emperor withdrew from the hall and reduced meals, reverently answering divine reproof.
translations.idiomatic: From the first day of the fourth month, the emperor withdrew from the hall and reduced his meals, reverently answering divine reproof.

sentences.zh: 癸未，程元鳳等以久旱乞解機務，詔不允。

translations.literal: On guiwei Cheng Yuanfeng and others begged to be relieved of state duties because of prolonged drought; an edict did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Cheng Yuanfeng and others asked to be relieved of state duties because of the prolonged drought; an edict refused.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大雨。

translations.literal: On jiashen heavy rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen heavy rain fell.

sentences.zh: 丙申，群臣三表請御正殿，從之。

translations.literal: On bingshen the assembled officials thrice submitted memorials requesting the emperor to attend the main hall; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the assembled officials thrice submitted memorials asking the emperor to attend the main hall; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔田應己思州駐紮御前忠勝軍副都統制，往播州共築關隘防禦。

translations.literal: On dingyou an edict ordered Tian Yingyi, vice overall controller of the Imperial Front Loyal Victory Army garrisoned at Si Prefecture, to proceed to Bozhou to jointly fortify passes and defend.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict ordered Tian Yingyi, vice overall controller of the Imperial Front Loyal Victory Army garrisoned at Si Prefecture, to proceed to Bozhou to help fortify passes and defenses.

sentences.zh: 己亥，台臣朱熠劾沿江制置副使呂好問黃州之役貪酷誤事，詔褫職。

translations.literal: On jihai censorial official Zhu Yi impeached Yangtzi coast deputy strategic commissioner Lü Haowen for greed and cruelty that caused failure at the battle of Huang Prefecture; an edict stripped him of office.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai censorial official Zhu Yi impeached Yangtzi coast deputy strategic commissioner Lü Haowen for greed and cruelty that caused the defeat at Huang Prefecture; an edict stripped him of office.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，程元鳳罷，以觀文殿學士判福州，尋提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: On yisi Cheng Yuanfeng was dismissed; he was made academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture administering Fuzhou; soon after he was made superintendent of the Cave of Heaven Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Cheng Yuanfeng was dismissed and appointed academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture administering Fuzhou; soon after he was appointed superintendent of the Cave of Heaven Abbey.

sentences.zh: 丙午，趙葵三辭免福建安撫使，詔授醴泉觀使兼侍讀。

translations.literal: On bingwu Zhao Kui thrice declined and begged to be relieved as Fujian pacification commissioner; an edict granted him Lichen Abbey superintendent and concurrent palace reader.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Zhao Kui thrice declined and asked to be relieved as Fujian pacification commissioner; an edict appointed him Lichen Abbey superintendent and concurrent palace reader.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以丁大全爲右丞相兼樞密使，林存同知樞密院事兼權參知政事，朱熠端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On dingwei Ding Daquan was made Right Chancellor and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs; Lin Cun vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and acting associate director of the Department of State Affairs; Zhu Yi academician of the Duanming Hall and associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Ding Daquan was appointed Right Chancellor and concurrent commissioner of military affairs; Lin Cun vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and acting associate director of the Department of State Affairs; and Zhu Yi academician of the Duanming Hall and associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌朔，詔襄、樊解圍，高達、程大元應援，李和城守，皆有勞績，將士用命，深可嘉尚，其亟議行賞激。

translations.literal: On the new moon gengxu of the fifth month, an edict stated that Xiangyang and Fancheng were relieved of siege; Gao Da and Cheng Dayuan had reinforced them and Li He had held the city, all with meritorious service; the officers and soldiers obeyed orders; this was deeply praiseworthy; rewards were to be deliberated and conferred promptly.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the fifth month, gengxu, an edict noted that Xiangyang and Fancheng had been relieved of siege; Gao Da and Cheng Dayuan had reinforced them and Li He had held the city, all with meritorious service; the officers and soldiers had obeyed orders; this was deeply praiseworthy; rewards were to be deliberated and conferred promptly.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔懷遠、漣水相繼奏功，夏貴官兩轉，兼河南招撫使。

translations.literal: On guichou an edict stated that Huaiyuan and Lianshui had successively reported achievements; Xia Gui was advanced two ranks and additionally made Henan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict noted that Huaiyuan and Lianshui had successively reported achievements; Xia Gui was promoted two ranks and additionally appointed Henan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 毛興轉右武大夫，並依舊任。

translations.literal: Mao Xing was transferred to Right Martial Grandee, retaining his former post.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Xing was transferred to Right Martial Grandee and retained his former post.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，李曾伯言：「廣西多荒田，民懼增賦不耕，乞許耕者復三年租，後兩年減其租之半，守令勸墾辟多者賞之。

translations.literal: On dingmao Li Zengbo stated: "Guangxi has much wasteland; the people fear increased taxation and do not cultivate; I beg permission for cultivators to have rent remitted for three years, then for the next two years half the rent reduced; prefects and magistrates who encourage reclamation shall be rewarded for doing much.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Li Zengbo stated: "Guangxi has much wasteland; the people fear increased taxation and do not cultivate; I ask that cultivators be allowed three years' rent remission, then half rent for the next two years; prefects and magistrates who encourage reclamation shall be rewarded for doing much.

sentences.zh: 」奏可。

translations.literal: "The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命嗣榮王與芮判大宗正事。

translations.literal: On bingyin the heir Prince of Rong Wang Yirui was ordered to administer the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the heir Prince of Rong Wang Yirui was ordered to administer the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，嗣秀王師彌薨。

translations.literal: On dingmao the heir Prince of Xiu Wang Shimi died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the heir Prince of Xiu Wang Shimi died.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，台臣戴慶炣劾淮東總領趙與時，奪職鐫秩。

translations.literal: On guisi in the sixth month, censorial official Dai Qingke impeached Huaidong fiscal commissioner Zhao Yushi; his office was removed and his rank degraded.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guisi, censorial official Dai Qingke impeached Huaidong fiscal commissioner Zhao Yushi; his office was removed and his rank degraded.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，城淩霄山，詔朱禩孫進一秩，易士英帶行閣門宣贊，餘轉官有差。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on gengxu, Lingxiao Mountain was fortified; an edict ordered Zhu Suisun advanced one rank, Yi Shiying granted acting Palace Gate Herald, and the rest promoted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengxu, Lingxiao Mountain was fortified; an edict ordered Zhu Suisun promoted one rank, Yi Shiying granted acting palace gate herald, and the others promoted according to merit.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，熒惑犯房宿。

translations.literal: On guichou Mars transgressed the Room constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Mars transgressed the Room constellation.

sentences.zh: 戊午，趙葵四辭免醴泉觀使兼侍讀，乞外祠，從之。

translations.literal: On wuwu Zhao Kui four times declined and begged to be relieved as Lichen Abbey superintendent and concurrent palace reader, requesting an outer temple post; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Zhao Kui four times declined and asked to be relieved as Lichen Abbey superintendent and concurrent palace reader, requesting an outer temple post; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，蜀郡劉整上捷，詔推恩賞。

translations.literal: On wuchen Sichuan prefecture Liu Zheng reported victory; an edict ordered extended rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Liu Zheng of Sichuan reported victory; an edict ordered extended rewards.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，知平江府余晦，以台臣戴慶炣言曩敗績於蜀，誤國欺君，詔奪寶章閣待制罷任，追冒支官錢。

translations.literal: On guiyou Prefect of Pingjiang Yu Hui, on censorial official Dai Qingke's memorial that he had formerly been defeated in Sichuan and deceived the state and the sovereign, was by edict stripped of Attendant Gentleman of the Baozhang Pavilion and dismissed from office, and falsely disbursed official funds were to be recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Prefect of Pingjiang Yu Hui, on censorial official Dai Qingke's memorial that he had formerly been defeated in Sichuan and had deceived the state and the sovereign, was by edict stripped of Attendant Gentleman of the Baozhang Pavilion and dismissed from office, and falsely disbursed official funds were to be recovered.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔前福建漕臣高斯得已奪職鐫官，其贓百余萬嚴限征償，以懲貪吏。

translations.literal: On jiaxu an edict stated that former Fujian transport commissioner Gao Side had already had office removed and rank degraded; his embezzled funds of more than one million were to be strictly recovered within a deadline, to punish greedy officials.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an edict stated that former Fujian transport commissioner Gao Side had already been removed from office and degraded in rank; his embezzled funds of more than one million were to be strictly recovered within a deadline, to punish greedy officials.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，呂文德入播州，詔京湖給銀萬兩。

translations.literal: On yihai Lü Wende entered Bozhou; an edict ordered Jing-Hu to supply ten thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Lü Wende entered Bozhou; an edict ordered Jing-Hu to supply ten thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，太陰行犯熒惑。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on guiwei, the Moon in its course transgressed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guiwei, the Moon in its course transgressed Mars.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔上流鎖江防禦。

translations.literal: On wuxu an edict ordered upper Yangzi river-lock defense.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict ordered defenses along the upper Yangzi river locks.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔申嚴倭船入界之禁。

translations.literal: On guimao an edict ordered strict enforcement of the prohibition on Japanese ships entering the border.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao an edict ordered strict enforcement of the prohibition on Japanese ships entering the border.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，詔蜀、廣、海道申嚴防遏。

translations.literal: On renzi an edict ordered Sichuan, Guangnan, and maritime routes to strictly enforce defense and interdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi an edict ordered Sichuan, Guangnan, and the maritime routes to strictly enforce defense and interdiction.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔安南情狀叵測，申飭邊防。

translations.literal: On jiayin an edict stated that Annam's situation was unpredictable and ordered strict admonition of the frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin an edict stated that Annam's situation was unpredictable and ordered strict admonition of the frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，安豐上戰功。

translations.literal: On wuchen Anfeng reported battle achievements.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Anfeng reported battle achievements.

sentences.zh: 有流星透霞。

translations.literal: A meteor pierced the clouds.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor pierced the clouds.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子朔，詔蜀中將帥雖未克復成都，而暴露日久，戰功亦多，宜與序升，其亟條具以聞。

translations.literal: On the new moon bingzi of the tenth month of winter, an edict stated that although Sichuan commanders had not yet recovered Chengdu, they had long been exposed to hardship and had many battle achievements; they should be promoted in order; they were to submit detailed lists promptly in memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the tenth month of winter, bingzi, an edict stated that although Sichuan commanders had not yet recovered Chengdu, they had long endured hardship and had many battle achievements; they should be promoted in order; detailed lists were to be submitted promptly in memorial.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以俞興爲四川制置副使、知嘉定府兼成都安撫副使。

translations.literal: On dingchou Yu Xing was made Sichuan deputy strategic commissioner, prefect of Jia Prefecture, and concurrent Chengdu deputy pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Yu Xing was appointed Sichuan deputy strategic commissioner, prefect of Jia Prefecture, and concurrent Chengdu deputy pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔知隆慶府楊禮守安西堡有功，官兩轉。

translations.literal: On yiyou an edict stated that Prefect of Long Prefecture Yang Li's defense of Anxi Fort had merit; he was advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou an edict noted that Prefect of Long Prefecture Yang Li's defense of Anxi Fort had merit; he was promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大元兵攻通、泰州。

translations.literal: On wuzi Great Yuan troops attacked Tong and Tai prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Great Yuan troops attacked Tong and Tai prefectures.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，廣南劉雄飛奏橫山之功，詔雄飛官三轉，部兵將校官兩轉。

translations.literal: On gengyin Guangnan Liu Xiongfei reported achievement at Hengshan; an edict ordered Xiongfei advanced three ranks and his subordinate officers and soldiers two ranks each.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Xiongfei of Guangnan reported achievement at Hengshan; an edict ordered Xiongfei promoted three ranks and his subordinate officers and soldiers two ranks each.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔常州、江陰、鎮江發米振贍淮民。

translations.literal: On xinmao an edict ordered Chang, Jiangyin, and Zhenjiang to distribute grain to relieve the Huai people.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao an edict ordered Chang, Jiangyin, and Zhenjiang to distribute grain to relieve the Huai people.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，林存罷，以資政殿學士知建寧府。

translations.literal: On jiyou Lin Cun was dismissed; he was made academician of the Hall for Promoting Governance and prefect of Jian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，潁州上戰功，詔亟推賞，以示激厲。

sentences.zh: 詔追復余玠官職。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yu Jie's offices posthumously restored.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yu Jie's offices posthumously restored.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，築黃平，賜名鎮遠州，呂逢年進一秩。

translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Huangping was fortified and granted the name Zhenyuan Prefecture; Lü Fengnian was promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 詔撫諭沿邊將士。

translations.literal: An edict ordered consolation and admonition of frontier officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered consolation and admonition of frontier officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，給事中張鎮言：徐敏子曩帥廣右，嗜殺黷貨，流毒桂府。

translations.literal: On bingchen Supervising Censor Zhang Zhen stated: Xu Minzi formerly commanded right Guang, was addicted to killing and corrupt in goods, and spread poison in Gui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Supervising Censor Zhang Zhen stated that Xu Minzi, who had formerly commanded right Guang, was addicted to killing and corrupt in goods and had spread poison in Gui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔仍舊羈管隆興府。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him continuing under supervised confinement in Long Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him to remain under supervised confinement in Long Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，葉夢鼎依舊職知隆興府。

translations.literal: On dingsi Ye Mengding continuing in his post as prefect of Long Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Ye Mengding was reappointed to his post as prefect of Long Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以朱熠同知樞密院事兼權參知政事，饒虎臣端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事，賈似道樞密使、兩淮宣撫使。

translations.literal: On renxu Zhu Yi was made vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and acting associate director of the Department of State Affairs; Rao Huchen academician of the Duanming Hall and concurrent associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Jia Sidao Commissioner of Military Affairs and Huai pacification commissioner for both circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Zhu Yi was appointed vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and acting associate director of the Department of State Affairs; Rao Huchen academician of the Duanming Hall and concurrent associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; and Jia Sidao commissioner of military affairs and Huai pacification commissioner for both circuits.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太陰犯權星。

translations.literal: On jiazi the Moon transgressed the Authority Star.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Moon transgressed the Authority Star.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，東海失守，賈似道抗章引咎，詔令以功自贖，特與放罪。

translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the East Sea was lost; Jia Sidao submitted a memorial accepting blame; an edict ordered him to redeem himself through merit and specially granted pardon.

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Huaidong commander reported that Great Yuan troops had withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Huaidong commander reported that Great Yuan troops had withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 填星、熒惑在危。

translations.literal: Saturn and Mars were in the Rooftop mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn and Mars were in the Rooftop constellation.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，詔改來年爲開慶元年。

translations.literal: On wuyin in the twelfth month, an edict changed the coming year to the first year of Kaiqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuyin, an edict changed the coming year to the first year of Kaiqing.

translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Great Yuan troops crossed Ma Lake and entered Sichuan; an edict ordered Ma Guangzu temporarily to move his headquarters to Xia Prefecture and Six Prefectures pacification commissioner Xiang Shibi to move his headquarters to Shao Prefecture, to facilitate coordinated response.

sentences.zh: 癸未，房州上戰功。

translations.literal: On guiwei Fang Prefecture reported battle achievements.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Fang Prefecture reported battle achievements.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔置橫山屯。

translations.literal: On bingxu an edict ordered establishment of the Hengshan garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu an edict ordered establishment of the Hengshan garrison.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，向士璧不俟朝命進師歸州，捐貲百萬以供軍費；

translations.literal: On dinghai Xiang Shibi without awaiting court orders advanced troops to Gui Prefecture and contributed one million in funds for military expenses;
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Xiang Shibi, without awaiting court orders, advanced troops to Gui Prefecture and contributed one million in funds for military expenses;

sentences.zh: 馬光祖不待奏請招兵萬人。

translations.literal: Ma Guangzu without awaiting memorial approval recruited ten thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Guangzu, without awaiting memorial approval, recruited ten thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 捐奉銀萬兩以募壯士，遂有房州之功。

translations.literal: He contributed ten thousand taels of salary silver to recruit stalwart men, and thus there was the achievement at Fang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He contributed ten thousand taels of salary silver to recruit stalwart men, and thus the achievement at Fang Prefecture was won.

sentences.zh: 詔士璧、光祖各進一秩。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Shibi and Guangzu each advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Shibi and Guangzu each promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔李曾伯城築關隘，訓練民兵峒丁，申嚴防遏。

translations.literal: On xinchou an edict ordered Li Zengbo to fortify cities and build passes, train militia and cave troops, and strictly enforce defense and interdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou an edict ordered Li Zengbo to fortify cities and build passes, train militia and cave troops, and strictly enforce defense and interdiction.

sentences.zh: 填星、太白、熒惑合於室。

translations.literal: Saturn, Venus, and Mars conjoined in the Encampment mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn, Venus, and Mars conjoined in the Encampment constellation.

sentences.zh: 開慶元年春正月乙巳朔，詔飭中外奉公法，圖實政。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiqing, first month of spring, on yisi the new moon day, an edict ordered discipline throughout court and realm to observe public law and pursue substantive governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaiqing, on the new moon of the first month of spring, yisi, an edict ordered court and realm to uphold public law and pursue substantive governance.

sentences.zh: 馬光祖與執政恩數。

translations.literal: Ma Guangzu was granted the favors of the chief administrators.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Guangzu was granted the privileges of the chief administrators.

sentences.zh: 李曾伯進觀文殿學士。

translations.literal: Li Zengbo was promoted to academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zengbo was promoted to academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture.

sentences.zh: 己酉，大元兵攻忠、涪，漸薄夔境，詔蒲擇之、馬光祖戰守調遣，便宜行事。

translations.literal: On jiyou Great Yuan troops attacked Zhong and Fu, gradually pressing near Kui territory; an edict ordered Pu Zezhi and Ma Guangzu to arrange warfare and defense and to act at their discretion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Great Yuan troops attacked Zhong and Fu and gradually neared Kui territory; an edict empowered Pu Zezhi and Ma Guangzu to arrange defense and deployments and act at their discretion.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔：「戍蜀將士，頻年戰禦，暴露可閔。

translations.literal: On xinhai an edict stated: "Sichuan garrison troops, for years fighting in defense, exposed to the elements - pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai an edict stated: "The troops garrisoned in Sichuan have fought in defense for years; their exposure to the elements is pitiable.

sentences.zh: 今申命蒲擇之從優犒師，春防畢日即與更戍，其輒逃歸者從軍令。

translations.literal: Now an order is issued to Pu Zezhi to reward the army generously; when the spring defense period ends they shall rotate garrison; those who flee and return shall be dealt with under military law.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Zezhi is now ordered to reward the troops generously; when the spring defense period ends they shall be rotated; deserters shall be punished under military law.

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，詔呂文德城黃平，深入蠻地，撫輯有方，與官三轉。

translations.literal: " On guichou an edict noted that Lü Wende had fortified Huangping, deeply entered barbarian lands, and pacified and assembled effectively; he was granted three rank promotions.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict noted that Lü Wende had fortified Huangping, penetrated deep into barbarian territory, and governed the pacification effectively; he was granted three rank promotions.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔知賓州呂振龍，知象州奚必勝，兵至聞風先遁，兵退乃返，並追毀出身文字，竄遠郡。

translations.literal: On gengshen an edict concerning Bin Prefecture prefect Lü Zhenlong and Xiang Prefecture prefect Xi Bisheng: when troops arrived they fled at the report before engaging; when troops withdrew they returned; both had their credentials of appointment traced and destroyed and were banished to distant prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict punished Bin Prefecture prefect Lü Zhenlong and Xiang Prefecture prefect Xi Bisheng, who had fled at the first report of enemy troops and only returned after they withdrew; both had their appointment documents revoked and were exiled to distant prefectures.

sentences.zh: 橫州守臣劉清卿設隘堅守，與官一轉。

translations.literal: Heng Prefecture defending official Liu Qingqing set up passes and held firm; he was granted one rank promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Heng Prefecture defending official Liu Qingqing fortified passes and held firm; he was promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，監察御史章士元言謝方叔帥蜀誤國，詔方叔更與鐫秩，其子修竄廣南。

translations.literal: On renxu Supervising Censor Zhang Shiyuan stated that Xie Fangshu as Sichuan commander had harmed the state; an edict ordered Fangshu further demoted in rank, and his son Xiu banished to Guangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Supervising Censor Zhang Shiyuan charged that Xie Fangshu as Sichuan commander had harmed the state; an edict further demoted Fangshu in rank and banished his son Xiu to Guangnan.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，左司諫沈炎言余晦壞蜀，幕屬李卓、王克己濟惡斂怨，詔晦、卓、克己各奪兩官。

translations.literal: On guihai Left Remonstrance Bureau Censor Shen Yan stated that Yu Hui had ruined Sichuan and staff members Li Zhuo and Wang Keji abetted evil and collected resentment; an edict stripped Yu Hui, Li Zhuo, and Wang Keji each of two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Left Remonstrance Bureau Censor Shen Yan charged that Yu Hui had ruined Sichuan and that staff members Li Zhuo and Wang Keji abetted wrongdoing and stirred resentment; an edict stripped Yu Hui, Li Zhuo, and Wang Keji each of two ranks.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，印應飛依舊職知鄂州兼湖北轉運使。

translations.literal: On bingyin Yin Yingfei was reappointed to his former post as prefect of E Prefecture and concurrently Hubei transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Yin Yingfei was reappointed to his former post as prefect of E Prefecture and concurrently Hubei transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賈似道以樞密使爲京西湖南北四川宣撫大使、都大提舉兩淮兵甲、湖廣總領、知江陵府。

translations.literal: On dingmao Jia Sidao, from his post as Privy Council marshal, was made grand commissioner for pacification of Western Hunan, Southern Hunan, Northern Hunan, and Sichuan, overall director of Lianghuai arms, overall fiscal commissioner of Huguang, and prefect of Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Jia Sidao was appointed from the Privy Council marshalship to grand commissioner for pacification of Western Hunan, Southern Hunan, Northern Hunan, and Sichuan, overall director of Lianghuai arms, overall fiscal commissioner of Huguang, and prefect of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 蜀帥蒲擇之以重兵攻成都，不克。

translations.literal: Sichuan commander Pu Zezhi attacked Chengdu with heavy troops but could not capture it.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan commander Pu Zezhi attacked Chengdu with a large force but failed to take it.

sentences.zh: 大元兵破利州、隆慶、順慶諸郡，閬、蓬、廣安守將相繼納降，又造浮梁於涪州之藺市。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops broke Lizhou, Longqing, and Shunqing prefectures; the defending generals of Lang, Peng, and Guang'an surrendered in succession; they also built a floating bridge at Lin Market in Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan troops captured Lizhou, Longqing, and Shunqing prefectures; the defending generals of Lang, Peng, and Guang'an surrendered one after another; they also built a floating bridge at Lin Market in Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以李庭芝權知揚州。

translations.literal: On wuchen Li Tingzhi was appointed acting prefect of Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Li Tingzhi was appointed acting prefect of Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥朔，詔京西提刑王登提兵援蜀，功未及成，齎志以歿，贈官五轉，致仕恩外，仍官一子。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yihai the new moon day, an edict noted that Western Zhejiang intendant Wang Deng had led troops to aid Sichuan; merit had not yet been achieved and he died with unfulfilled ambition; he was posthumously promoted five ranks, and beyond retirement honors one son was still appointed to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon, yihai, an edict noted that Western Zhejiang intendant Wang Deng had led troops to aid Sichuan; before success was won he died with his ambition unfulfilled; he was posthumously promoted five ranks, and in addition to retirement honors one son was appointed to office.

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，以趙與𥲅爲觀文殿學士、兩淮安撫制置使兼知揚州。

translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Zhao Yuqi was appointed academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, Lianghuai pacification and strategic commissioner, and concurrent prefect of Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，出內庫緡錢三千萬助邊用。

translations.idiomatic: On yiyou three million strings of cash were released from the inner treasury to assist frontier expenses.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以馬光祖爲資政殿學士、沿江制置使、江東安撫、知建康府、行宮留守。

translations.literal: On bingxu Ma Guangzu was appointed academician of the Hall for Promoting Governance, Yanjiang strategic commissioner, Jiangdong pacification commissioner, prefect of Jiankang, and palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Ma Guangzu was appointed academician of the Hall for Promoting Governance, Yanjiang strategic commissioner, Jiangdong pacification commissioner, prefect of Jiankang, and palace attendant.

translations.idiomatic: On jichou an edict remitted sand-field rent in Jiankang, Taiping, Ningguo, Chizhou, Guangde, and other places.

translations.literal: On renchen an edict remitted garrison-farm rent collected by the Lianshui Army strategic headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict remitted garrison-farm rent collected by the Lianshui Army strategic headquarters.

sentences.zh: 乙未，發平糶倉米三萬，減直振在京民。

translations.idiomatic: On yiwei thirty thousand piculs of rice were issued from the relief granary at reduced price to relieve the people of the capital.

translations.literal: On xinchou Fu Prefecture reported that Great Yuan troops had withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Fu Prefecture reported that Great Yuan troops had withdrawn.

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengxu, an edict ordered Yin Yinglei and Huang Menggui to come to the chief council hall for consultation.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengxu, an edict ordered Yin Yinglei and Huang Menggui to come to the chief council hall for consultation.

sentences.zh: 命有司縣重賞募將士，毀藺市浮梁。

translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices were ordered to offer heavy rewards to recruit officers and soldiers to destroy the floating bridge at Lin Market.

translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict ordered posthumous honors and recognition of the descendants of loyal martyrs of Sichuan and the officers and soldiers at Yunding Mountain and other places.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以呂文德爲保康軍節度使、四川制置副使兼知重慶府。

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Lü Wende was appointed military commissioner of Baokang Army, deputy Sichuan strategic commissioner, and concurrent prefect of Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 庚申，馬光祖奏大元兵自烏江還北。

translations.literal: On gengshen Ma Guangzu memorialized that Great Yuan troops had returned north from Wujiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Ma Guangzu reported that Great Yuan troops had returned north from Wujiang.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，雨土。

translations.literal: On xinyou dust rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou dust rained from the sky.

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiaxu the new moon day, because Duan Yuanjian and Yang Lijian had held the city walls and died in the king's service, an edict posthumously granted each the military governorship of Fengguo Army, enfeoffment as a two-character marquis, and the erection of a temple with a granted name plaque.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon, jiaxu, because Duan Yuanjian and Yang Lijian had held the city walls and died in the king's service, an edict posthumously granted each the military governorship of Fengguo Army, enfeoffment as a two-character marquis, and the erection of a temple with a granted name plaque.

sentences.zh: 致仕恩外，更官一子成忠郎。

translations.literal: Beyond retirement honors, one son was additionally appointed Gentleman for Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond retirement honors, one son was additionally appointed Gentleman for Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以向士璧爲湖北安撫副使、知峽州，兼歸、峽、施、珍、南平軍、紹慶府鎮撫使。

translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Xiang Shibi was appointed deputy Hubei pacification commissioner and prefect of Xia Prefecture, and concurrently pacification commissioner of Gui, Xia, Shi, Zhen, Nanping Army, and Shao Prefecture.

translations.literal: On jiashen an edict stated: "He Prefecture defender Wang Jian held the city firm through siege, fought a hundred battles with growing fierceness, and his integrity and righteousness were the crown among Sichuan's walled cities; an edict ordered enhanced rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen an edict stated: "He Prefecture defender Wang Jian held the city firm through siege, fought a hundred battles with growing fierceness, and his integrity and righteousness were the crown among Sichuan's walled cities; enhanced rewards were ordered.

translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Shi Prefecture prefect Xie Changyuan, at his own expense, provided one million strings of cash and one thousand shi of grain and wheat and had merit in building the prefectural city; he was promoted one rank.

translations.literal: On yiwei an edict granted Xia Gui thirty qing of land in Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei an edict granted Xia Gui thirty qing of land in Liyang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以呂文德兼四川總領財賦。

translations.literal: On bingshen Lü Wende was additionally appointed overall Sichuan fiscal commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Lü Wende was additionally appointed overall Sichuan fiscal commissioner.

translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon, jiachen, Jin Prefecture and Kai Prefecture were fortified.

translations.idiomatic: On xinhai hail fell.

translations.idiomatic: On yimao Da Prefecture submitted the battle achievements of Lü Wende and others; an edict ordered promotion and appointment for meritorious officers and soldiers.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi an edict stated: "Last year Hubei prefectures suffered drought, flood, famine, and plague; Jiangling, Chang, Li, Yue, and Shou prefectures were ordered to release charity-granary rice for relief sale, with official abuses strictly curbed so that benefits would reach the common people.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，行開慶通寶錢。

translations.literal: On yichou Kaiqing tongbao coins were issued.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Kaiqing tongbao coins were issued.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賜禮部進士周震炎以下四百四十二人及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Ministry of Rites jinshi Zhou Zhenyan and four hundred forty-two others below him were granted jinshi degrees and initial appointments in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Ministry of Rites jinshi Zhou Zhenyan and four hundred forty-two others below him were granted jinshi degrees and initial appointments in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 婺州大水，發義倉米振之。

translations.literal: Wu Prefecture suffered great flood; charity-granary rice was released to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Prefecture suffered a great flood; charity-granary rice was released for relief.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，呂文德兵入重慶。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, Lü Wende's troops entered Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, Lü Wende's troops entered Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 詔諭四川軍民共奮忠勇，效死勿去，有功行賞，靡間邇遐。

translations.literal: An edict urged the military and civilians of Sichuan together to exert loyalty and courage, to die rather than leave, and that merit would be rewarded without distinction between near and far.
translations.idiomatic: An edict urged the military and civilians of Sichuan to exert loyalty and courage, to die rather than leave, and promised that merit would be rewarded without distinction between near and far.

sentences.zh: 有能效順來歸，悉當宥過加恤。

translations.literal: Those who could submit in loyalty and return would all be pardoned for past faults and shown additional favor.
translations.idiomatic: Those who submitted in loyalty and returned would all be pardoned for past faults and shown additional favor.

sentences.zh: 仍獎呂文德斷橋通道之功，命兼領馬軍行司。

translations.literal: Lü Wende was still rewarded for the merit of cutting the bridge and opening the passage, and was ordered additionally to head the Cavalry Mobile Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Wende was still rewarded for cutting the bridge and opening the passage, and was additionally ordered to head the Cavalry Mobile Bureau.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以朱熠參知政事，饒虎臣同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On xinsi Zhu Yi was appointed Vice Grand Councilor, and Rao Huchen Associate Privy Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Zhu Yi was appointed Vice Grand Councilor, and Rao Huchen Associate Privy Councilor.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，南平來報戰功。

translations.literal: On bingxu Nanping reported battle achievements.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Nanping reported battle achievements.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔申嚴海道防禦。

translations.literal: On wuxu an edict strictly enforced maritime-route defense.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict strictly enforced maritime-route defense.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔獎諭賈似道。

translations.literal: On jihai an edict rewarded and instructed Jia Sidao.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai an edict rewarded and instructed Jia Sidao.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以李庭芝直寶謨閣、湖北安撫副使兼知峽州。

translations.literal: On renyin Li Tingzhi was appointed Direct Attendant of the Baomo Pavilion, deputy Hubei pacification commissioner, and concurrent prefect of Xia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Li Tingzhi was appointed Direct Attendant of the Baomo Pavilion, deputy Hubei pacification commissioner, and concurrent prefect of Xia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: Venus was visible in the daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Venus was visible in the daytime.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，以濠州統制張斌柘塘之戰，歿于王事，贈官三轉，仍與一子下班祗應。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiashen, because Haozhou commander Zhang Bin had died in the king's service at the Battle of Zhetang, he was posthumously promoted three ranks and one son was granted lower-ranking attendant status.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiashen, because Haozhou commander Zhang Bin had died in the king's service at the Battle of Zhetang, he was posthumously promoted three ranks and one son was granted lower-ranking attendant status.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，降人來言：大元憲宗皇帝崩于軍中。

translations.literal: On yiyou surrendered persons reported that Great Yuan Emperor Xianzong had died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou surrendered persons reported that Great Yuan Emperor Xianzong had died in the army.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔吳潛開閫海道，勤勞三年，屢疏求退，仍舊觀文殿大學士、判寧國府、特進、崇國公。

translations.literal: On wuzi an edict noted that Wu Qian had opened the maritime-route command, toiled diligently for three years, and repeatedly submitted memorials requesting retirement; he was restored as grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, administrator of Ningguo Prefecture, specially advanced, and Duke of Chong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi an edict noted that Wu Qian had opened the maritime-route command, toiled diligently for three years, and repeatedly requested retirement; he was restored as grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, administrator of Ningguo Prefecture, specially advanced, and Duke of Chong.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命呂文德兼湖北安撫使。

translations.literal: On xinmao Lü Wende was ordered additionally to serve as Hubei pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Lü Wende was ordered additionally to serve as Hubei pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太白犯權星、熒惑。

translations.literal: On gengzi Venus transgressed the Authority Star and Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Venus transgressed the Authority Star and Mars.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，賈似道表言大元兵自黃州沙武口渡江、，中外震動。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renzi, Jia Sidao memorialized that Great Yuan troops had crossed the river from Shawukou in Huang Prefecture, and court and country were shaken.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi, Jia Sidao memorialized that Great Yuan troops had crossed the Yangtze at Shawukou in Huang Prefecture, shaking court and country.

sentences.zh: 己未，嗣濮王善騰薨。

translations.literal: On jiwei Heir Prince of Pu Shan Teng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Heir Prince of Pu Shan Teng died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以吳潛兼侍讀、奉朝請，戴慶炣端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On gengshen Wu Qian was additionally appointed palace reader and court attendee; Dai Qingke was appointed academician of the Duanming Hall and signing secretary of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wu Qian was additionally appointed palace reader and court attendee; Dai Qingke was appointed academician of the Duanming Hall and signing secretary of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 下詔責己，勉諭諸閫進兵。

translations.literal: An edict blaming himself was issued, and border commanders were urged to advance troops.
translations.idiomatic: An edict of self-reproach was issued, and border commanders were urged to advance troops.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔出內府緡錢千萬、銀五萬兩、帛五萬匹給宣司，緡錢五百萬、銀三萬兩、帛三萬匹給沿江副司犒師。

translations.literal: On renxu an edict released ten million strings of cash, fifty thousand taels of silver, and fifty thousand bolts of silk from the inner treasury to the Pacification Commission, and five million strings of cash, thirty thousand taels of silver, and thirty thousand bolts of silk to the Yanjiang deputy commission to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an edict released ten million strings of cash, fifty thousand taels of silver, and fifty thousand bolts of silk from the inner treasury to the Pacification Commission, and five million strings of cash, thirty thousand taels of silver, and thirty thousand bolts of silk to the Yanjiang deputy commission to reward the army.

sentences.zh: 詔：已命御史陳寅趣淮東調兵五萬，應援上流。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "The censor Chen Yin has already been ordered to hasten the mobilization of fifty thousand troops in Huaidong to reinforce the upper reaches.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Censor Chen Yin has already been ordered to hasten the mobilization of fifty thousand troops in Huaidong to reinforce the upper reaches.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，趙葵特進、觀文殿大學士，封衛國公，判慶元府、沿海制置使。

translations.literal: On guihai Zhao Kui was specially advanced, made grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, enfeoffed as Duke of Wei, and appointed administrator of Qingyuan Prefecture and coastal strategic commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhao Kui was specially advanced, made grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, enfeoffed as Duke of Wei, and appointed administrator of Qingyuan Prefecture and coastal strategic commissioner.

sentences.zh: 命侍御史沈炎往沿江制置副司趣兵援鄂渚。

translations.literal: Attendant Censor Shen Yan was ordered to go to the Yanjiang deputy strategic commission to hasten troops to aid Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Censor Shen Yan was ordered to go to the Yanjiang deputy strategic commission to hasten troops to aid Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 再出內庫緡錢五百萬、銀二萬兩、帛二萬匹給兩淮制司，緡錢三百萬、銀萬兩、帛萬匹給沿江制司，以備軍賞。

translations.literal: Again five million strings of cash, twenty thousand taels of silver, and twenty thousand bolts of silk were released from the inner treasury to the Lianghuai strategic commission, and three million strings of cash, ten thousand taels of silver, and ten thousand bolts of silk to the Yanjiang strategic commission, to prepare military rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Another five million strings of cash, twenty thousand taels of silver, and twenty thousand bolts of silk were released from the inner treasury to the Lianghuai strategic commission, and three million strings of cash, ten thousand taels of silver, and ten thousand bolts of silk to the Yanjiang strategic commission, to prepare military rewards.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太白犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On wuchen Venus transgressed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Venus transgressed Mars.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔賈似道兼節制江西、二廣人馬，通融應援上流。

translations.literal: On jisi an edict ordered Jia Sidao additionally to control the manpower of Jiangxi and the Two Guangs and flexibly reinforce the upper reaches.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi an edict ordered Jia Sidao additionally to control the manpower of Jiangxi and the Two Guangs and flexibly reinforce the upper reaches.

sentences.zh: 庚午，合州解圍，詔王堅寧遠軍節度使，依前左領軍衛上將軍、興元府駐紮御前諸軍都統制兼知合州、節制軍馬，進封清水縣開國伯。

translations.literal: On gengwu the siege of He Prefecture was lifted; an edict appointed Wang Jian military commissioner of Ningyuan Army, retaining his former posts as Left Commandery Guard Senior General, overall commander of the imperial armies stationed at Xing Prefecture, and concurrent prefect of He Prefecture and controller of military forces, and advanced his enfeoffment to State-founder Earl of Qingshui County.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the siege of He Prefecture was lifted; an edict appointed Wang Jian military commissioner of Ningyuan Army, retaining his former posts as Left Commandery Guard Senior General, overall commander of the imperial armies stationed at Xing Prefecture, and concurrent prefect of He Prefecture and controller of military forces, and advanced his enfeoffment to Earl of Qingshui County.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未朔，丁大全罷，以觀文殿大學士判鎮江府。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinwei the new moon day, Ding Daquan was dismissed and made grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture administering Zhenjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the new moon, xinwei, Ding Daquan was dismissed and appointed grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture administering Zhenjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以吳潛爲左丞相兼樞密使，進封相國公；

translations.literal: On renshen Wu Qian was appointed Left Chief Councilor and concurrent Privy Council marshal, and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Xiang;
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wu Qian was appointed Left Chief Councilor and concurrent Privy Council marshal, and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Xiang;

sentences.zh: 賈似道爲右丞相兼樞密使，進封茂國公，宣撫大使等如舊。

translations.literal: Jia Sidao was appointed Right Chief Councilor and concurrent Privy Council marshal, advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Mao, with his grand commissioner and other posts unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao was appointed Right Chief Councilor and concurrent Privy Council marshal, advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Mao, with his grand commissioner and other posts unchanged.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命趙葵爲江東宣撫使，馬光祖移司江州應援鄂州，史岩之沿江制置副使，移司壽昌軍應援鄂州。

translations.literal: On guiyou Zhao Kui was ordered to serve as Jiangdong grand commissioner for pacification; Ma Guangzu was to move headquarters to Ji Prefecture to reinforce E Prefecture; Shi Yanzhi was made Yanjiang deputy strategic commissioner and was to move headquarters to Shouchang Army to reinforce E Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Zhao Kui was ordered to serve as Jiangdong grand commissioner for pacification; Ma Guangzu was to move headquarters to Ji Prefecture to reinforce E Prefecture; Shi Yanzhi was made Yanjiang deputy strategic commissioner and was to move headquarters to Shouchang Army to reinforce E Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙子，改封吳潛爲慶國公。

translations.literal: On bingzi Wu Qian's enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Wu Qian's enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Qing.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔給還浙西提舉常平司歲收上亭戶沙地租二百萬，永勿復征。

translations.literal: On dingchou an edict ordered the return of two million in annual sand-field rent collected from shangting households by the Zhexi commissioner for ever-normal granaries, never to be levied again.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou an edict ordered the return of two million in annual sand-field rent collected from shangting households by the Zhexi commissioner for ever-normal granaries, never to be levied again.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔合州圍解，宣閫制臣及二三大將之功，宜加優賞。

translations.literal: On gengchen an edict stated: "With the lifting of the siege of He Prefecture, the merits of the border commissioners and the two or three great generals should receive enhanced rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an edict stated: "With the lifting of the siege of He Prefecture, the merits of the border commissioners and the leading generals should receive enhanced rewards.

sentences.zh: 呂文德授檢校少師，李遇龍進三秩、權刑部侍郎，各賜金幣；

translations.literal: Lü Wende was appointed acting Junior Mentor; Li Yulong was promoted three ranks and made acting Vice Minister of Justice; each was granted gold and silk;
translations.idiomatic: Lü Wende was appointed acting Junior Mentor; Li Yulong was promoted three ranks and made acting Vice Minister of Justice; each was granted gold and silk;

sentences.zh: 將佐以下，進秩、賜金有差。

translations.literal: subordinate officers and below received rank promotions and grants of gold in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate officers and below received rank promotions and grants of gold in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 詔自今月十一日始，避殿減膳徹樂。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that from the eleventh day of this month the emperor would avoid the main hall, reduce meals, and withdraw music.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that from the eleventh day of this month the emperor would avoid the main hall, reduce meals, and withdraw music.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「比者蜀道稍寧，然干戈之餘，瘡痍未復，流離蕩析，生聚何資。

translations.literal: Another edict stated: "Recently the Sichuan route has been somewhat peaceful, yet after the ravages of war wounds are not yet healed, the displaced are scattered and destitute, and what resources remain for gathering the people?
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "Recently the Sichuan route has been somewhat peaceful, yet after the ravages of war wounds are not yet healed, the displaced are scattered and destitute, and what resources remain for gathering the people?

sentences.zh: 咨爾旬宣之寄，牧守之臣，輕徭薄賦，一意撫摩，恤軍勞民，庶底興復。

translations.literal: I charge you regional commissioners and prefectural defenders: lighten corvee and taxes, devote yourselves wholly to soothing the people, care for the army and relieve the people, and thereby perhaps achieve revival.
translations.idiomatic: I charge you regional commissioners and prefectural defenders to lighten corvee and taxes, devote yourselves wholly to soothing the people, care for the army and relieve the people, and thereby achieve revival.

sentences.zh: 其被兵百姓，遷入城郭，無以自存者，三省下各郡以財粟振之。

translations.literal: As for war-affected commoners who moved into walled cities and had no means to support themselves, the Three Departments were to issue orders to each prefecture to relieve them with funds and grain.
translations.idiomatic: War-affected commoners who moved into walled cities and had no means to support themselves were to be relieved with funds and grain under orders from the Three Departments to each prefecture.

sentences.zh: 」壬午，御史陳寅言：知江州袁玠貪贓不悛，殘賤州邑。

translations.literal: " On renwu Censor Chen Yin stated: "Ji Prefecture prefect Yuan Jie was greedy and corrupt without repentance and cruelly debased the prefecture and its districts.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Censor Chen Yin stated: "Ji Prefecture prefect Yuan Jie was greedy and corrupt without repentance and cruelly debased the prefecture and its districts.

sentences.zh: 詔削玠五秩、竄南雄州。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Jie of five ranks and banished him to Nanxiong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped Jie of five ranks and banished him to Nanxiong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸未，丁大全落職、罷新任。

translations.literal: On guiwei Ding Daquan was removed from office and dismissed from his new appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Ding Daquan was removed from office and dismissed from his new appointment.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，雷。

translations.literal: On yiyou thunder sounded.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou thunder sounded.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以趙葵爲沿江、江東宣撫使，置司建康，任責捍禦。

translations.literal: On bingxu Zhao Kui was appointed Yanjiang and Jiangdong grand commissioner for pacification, with headquarters at Jiankang, charged with responsibility for defense.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zhao Kui was appointed Yanjiang and Jiangdong grand commissioner for pacification, with headquarters at Jiankang, charged with responsibility for defense.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，向士璧權兵部侍郎、湖南安撫使兼知潭州，任責廣西邊防。

translations.literal: On guisi Xiang Shibi was appointed acting Vice Minister of War, Hunan pacification commissioner, and concurrent prefect of Tan Prefecture, charged with responsibility for Guangxi frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Xiang Shibi was appointed acting Vice Minister of War, Hunan pacification commissioner, and concurrent prefect of Tan Prefecture, charged with responsibility for Guangxi frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，以朱熠權知樞密院事，饒虎臣、戴慶炣並權參知政事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renyin, Zhu Yi was appointed acting Privy Councilor; Rao Huchen and Dai Qingke were both appointed acting Vice Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renyin, Zhu Yi was appointed acting Privy Councilor; Rao Huchen and Dai Qingke were both appointed acting Vice Grand Councilors.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，呂文福帶遙郡防禦使、河南招撫使、知淮安軍。

translations.literal: On guimao Lü Wenfu was appointed remote-prefecture defense commissioner, Henan recruitment commissioner, and prefect of Huai'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Lü Wenfu was appointed remote-prefecture defense commissioner, Henan recruitment commissioner, and prefect of Huai'an Army.

sentences.zh: 詔追毀袁玠出身以來文字，除名不敘，移萬安軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yuan Jie's appointment documents since his first office traced and destroyed, his name removed from the rolls, and his transfer to Wanan Army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yuan Jie's appointment documents since his first office revoked, his name removed from the rolls, and his transfer to Wanan Army.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔求直言。

translations.literal: On wushen an edict sought blunt counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict sought blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，舟師戰滸黃洲。

translations.literal: On xinhai naval forces fought at Huhuang Isle.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai naval forces fought at Huhuang Isle.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔趙葵授少保、觀文殿大學士、江東西宣撫使，進封益國公，其饒、信、袁、臨、撫、吉、隆興官軍民兵，並聽節制調遣，諮訪、罷行、黜陟皆得便宜行事。

translations.literal: On yimao an edict appointed Zhao Kui Junior Mentor, grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, and grand commissioner for pacification of Jiang East and West, advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Yi; the regular armies and militia of Rao, Xin, Yuan, Lin, Fu, Ji, and Longxing were all placed under his control and deployment, and in consultation, dismissal, promotion, and demotion he was empowered to act at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao an edict appointed Zhao Kui Junior Mentor, grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture, and grand commissioner for pacification of Jiang East and West, advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Yi; the regular armies and militia of Rao, Xin, Yuan, Lin, Fu, Ji, and Longxing were all placed under his control and deployment, and he was empowered to consult, dismiss, promote, and demote at discretion.

sentences.zh: 以緡錢五百萬、銀五萬兩給其用。

translations.literal: Five million strings of cash and fifty thousand taels of silver were granted for his use.
translations.idiomatic: Five million strings of cash and fifty thousand taels of silver were granted for his use.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔選精銳招信、泗州千人，揚州拱衛軍千人，安豐、濠州各千五百人，赴京聽調遣。

translations.literal: On bingchen an edict ordered the selection of elite troops: one thousand from Zhaoxin and Si Prefectures, one thousand from the Yangzhou Palace Guard Army, and fifteen hundred each from Anfeng and Haozhou, to come to the capital awaiting deployment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict ordered elite troops selected: one thousand from Zhaoxin and Si Prefectures, one thousand from the Yangzhou Palace Guard Army, and fifteen hundred each from Anfeng and Haozhou, to come to the capital awaiting deployment.

sentences.zh: 庚申，夏貴入見，帝撫勞甚至。

translations.literal: On gengshen Xia Gui had an audience with the emperor, and the emperor consoled and praised him exceedingly.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Xia Gui had an audience with the emperor, who consoled and praised him exceedingly.

sentences.zh: 閏十一月甲戌，詔出內帑緡錢五千萬犒內外諸軍。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eleventh month, on jiaxu, an edict released fifty million strings of cash from the inner treasury to reward the armies inside and outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eleventh month, on jiaxu, an edict released fifty million strings of cash from the inner treasury to reward the armies inside and outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以向士璧爲湖南制置副使，餘職仍舊，賜金帶。

translations.literal: On dingchou Xiang Shibi was appointed deputy Hunan strategic commissioner, with his other posts unchanged, and was granted a gold belt.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Xiang Shibi was appointed deputy Hunan strategic commissioner, retaining his other posts, and was granted a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 己卯，熒惑入氐。

translations.literal: On jimao Mars entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Mars entered the Root mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸未，諸將陶林、文通進兵有功，詔林帶行遙郡刺史，文通轉武功大夫，賜銀有差。

translations.literal: On guiwei the generals Tao Lin and Wen Tong had advanced with troops and achieved merit; an edict granted Tao Lin acting status as remote-prefecture prefect, promoted Wen Tong to Grand Master of Martial Achievement, and bestowed silver in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the generals Tao Lin and Wen Tong had advanced with troops and achieved merit; an edict granted Tao Lin acting status as remote-prefecture prefect, promoted Wen Tong to Grand Master of Martial Achievement, and bestowed silver in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以印應雷爲軍器監、淮西總領財賦兼江東轉運判官，呂文德檢校少保、京西湖北安撫使兼制置使、知鄂州兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On jiashen Yin Yinglei was appointed director of the Directorate of Military Equipment, Huaixi fiscal commissioner, and concurrent Jiangdong transport vice commissioner; Lü Wende was made acting Junior Preceptor, Jingxi-Hubei pacification commissioner and concurrent strategic commissioner, prefect of E Prefecture, and commander of the Palace Horse Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Yin Yinglei was appointed director of the Directorate of Military Equipment, Huaixi fiscal commissioner, and concurrent Jiangdong transport vice commissioner; Lü Wende was made acting Junior Preceptor, Jingxi-Hubei pacification commissioner and concurrent strategic commissioner, prefect of E Prefecture, and commander of the Palace Horse Army.

sentences.zh: 己丑，皮龍榮兼資善堂翊善。

translations.literal: On jichou Pi Longrong was additionally appointed assistant tutor of the Hall for Nurturing Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Pi Longrong was additionally appointed assistant tutor of the Hall for Nurturing Goodness.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，陶林奏沼山寺戰功。

translations.literal: On gengyin Tao Lin submitted a report on the battle merit at Zhaoshan Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Tao Lin submitted a report on the battle merit at Zhaoshan Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，向士璧連以功狀來上。

translations.literal: On guisi Xiang Shibi repeatedly submitted reports of merit.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Xiang Shibi repeatedly submitted reports of merit.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔降周震炎第四甲出身。

translations.literal: On yiwei an edict granted Zhou Zhenyan examination success in the fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei an edict granted Zhou Zhenyan examination success in the fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賈似道表：大戰數合，皆有功。

translations.literal: On bingshen Jia Sidao submitted a memorial stating that in several major battles, each engagement had produced merit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Jia Sidao submitted a memorial stating that in several major engagements his forces had all achieved merit.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥朔，賈似道言鄂州圍解，詔論功行賞。

translations.literal: On the new moon of the twelfth month, jihai, Jia Sidao reported that the siege of E Prefecture had been lifted; an edict ordered merit assessed and rewards distributed.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month, jihai, Jia Sidao reported that the siege of E Prefecture had been lifted; an edict ordered merit assessed and rewards distributed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，熒惑犯房宿、鉤鈐星。

translations.literal: On dingwei Mars transgressed the Room mansion and the Hook and Lock stars.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Mars transgressed the Room mansion and the Hook and Lock stars.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔改來年爲景定元年。

translations.literal: On xinhai an edict changed the coming year to the first year of Jingding.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai an edict changed the coming year to the first year of Jingding.

sentences.zh: 壬子，改封吳潛爲許國公，賈似道爲肅國公。

translations.literal: On renzi Wu Qian was re-enfeoffed as Duke of Xu, and Jia Sidao as Duke of Su.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Wu Qian was re-enfeoffed as Duke of Xu, and Jia Sidao as Duke of Su.
